jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Fiscal (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
Join Apaleo and Shape the Future of Hospitality Tech!

 At Apaleo, we're building the open, API-first property management platform for hospitality. With integrations across hundreds of apps through the Apaleo Store, we simplify operations, elevate the guest journey and drive revenue growth for our customers. 

 We're looking for a Senior Product Manager - Fiscal (f/m/d) to help us make Apaleo compliant, fast, wherever we grow next. You'll own the delivery of features that keep our platform compliant across markets, working closely with a Senior Product Management Lead who sets the strategic direction for the wider fiscal and tax domain. 

 

 What You'll Be Up To 

 
 Owning the end to end delivery of one or two product crews within the fiscal and legal domain, for example invoicing or taxation. 

 
 
 Turning roadmap priorities into clear, well scoped work your engineering team can execute against. 

 
 
 Balancing planned roadmap delivery with the steady stream of regulatory and reactive work that comes with keeping Apaleo compliant in markets we've already launched. 

 
 
 Writing clear specs, defining what done looks like and following through on impact analysis so nothing falls through the cracks. 

 
 
 Working shoulder to shoulder with engineering as a technical partner. You'll get into the detail of our API-first architecture rather than handing off a ticket and waiting. 

 
 
 Shielding your team from noise and distractions so they can focus on what matters, whilst keeping delivery predictable. 

 
 
 Partnering with customer success, compliance and engineering stakeholders to understand what's needed and translate it into shippable work. 

 
 
 Helping the team move faster on new country launches, contributing to our ambition of making Apaleo compliant in many more markets over the next few years. 

 
 

 What You'll Bring to the Team 

 
 At least 3 to 4 years' experience as a Product Manager, ideally in a fast moving startup or scale up environment. 

 
 
 A strong execution mindset. You're energised by shipping, not just planning, and you take ownership of your product area without needing to be hand held. 

 
 
 Comfort working with technical, API-first products. You can talk architecture with engineers, challenge their thinking and understand what you're shipping in real depth. 

 
 
 Sharp prioritisation instincts. You know how to sequence work, say no to good ideas that aren't great ones, and keep a team focused day to day. 

 
 
 A genuine curiosity for complex domains. You dig into the details rather than staying at the surface, and you're not afraid of a codebase with some history to it. 

 
 
 Clear, confident communication with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 

 
 

 Extra Awesome Points For 

 
 Experience with fiscal, tax or legal compliance topics, for example in fintech, e-commerce or ERP systems. This is a genuine nice to have, not a requirement. 

 
 
 Familiarity with platform products where you expose APIs for others to build on. 

 
 

 What We Offer 

 
 A diverse, international team. Work alongside passionate people from all sorts of backgrounds, with a genuinely global perspective. 

 
 
 A flat, flexible structure. You'll get real autonomy and ownership, without unnecessary hierarchy in the way. 

 
 
 A key role in a fast growing startup, right in the heart of Munich. 

 
 
 Fair, transparent compensation with a clear peer review and career progression plan. 

 
 
 Flexible working, with hours and remote options that depend on the role. 

 
 
 Team events that are actually fun: cocktail nights, team dinners, meetups and our legendary Oktoberfest celebrations. 

 
 
 30 days of holiday to properly switch off and recharge. 

 
 
 Free public transport in Munich. Your commute, covered. 

 
 

 How You'll Make an Impact 

 Joining Apaleo means more than taking on a role. Your work will directly shape how quickly and reliably we can bring our platform to new markets, and the systems you help build will make life easier for every property that runs on Apaleo. Your voice matters here, and your impact will be easy to see. 

 Apaleo is proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer, committed to a diverse, inclusive and welcoming workplace. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, regardless of race, colour, religion, gender identity or expression, sex, national origin, age, marital status, disability or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Your personal data is handled with care and in line with GDPR and relevant data protection regulations.

jobs.title: Head of Product (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Hi, wir sind Doonails! 💅🏼 

 Ein schnell wachsendes Beauty-Startup, das die Manikürewelt revolutioniert. Mit innovativen Produkten, einer starken Community und Präsenz im Online-Shop sowie bei führenden Retail-Partnern bringen wir Studio-Qualität direkt zu unseren Kund:innen nach Hause, einfach, schnell und stilvoll.

 Und genau hier kommst DU ins Spiel.

 Für die nächste Wachstumsphase suchen wir dich als Head of Product (m/w/d) . Du berichtest direkt an unseren CEO und formst gemeinsam mit deinem Team das Produkt, das Doonails weiter wachsen lässt. ✨

 Deine Rolle & dein Impact ⚡️ 
 Als Head of Product verantwortest du die Performance unseres gesamten Produktportfolios und setzt die Produktrichtung für die nächsten 1-5 Jahre, über all unsere Categories hinweg, von Press-Ons und Gel Strips bis Care und Accessories.

 Deine zentralen Aufgaben 👩‍💻👨‍💻 
 
 Produktvision & Roadmap 

 
 Du entwickelst eine klare Produktstrategie über 1-5 Jahre und übersetzt sie in eine priorisierte Roadmap - nach Kundennutzen, Business Impact und Ressourcen.

 Du scoutest Beauty- und Nail-Trends systematisch und erkennst früh, welche Formate, Designs und Innovationen für Doonails relevant werden.

 Portfolio-Performance & Operations 

 
 Du verantwortest die qualitative und kommerzielle Performance des gesamten Portfolios - über alle Kategorien (Press-Ons, Gel Strips, Care, Accessories) hinweg - und stellst gemeinsam mit Retail und E-Com sicher, dass jedes Produkt markt- und verkaufsfähig aufgestellt ist.

 Du begleitest den Produktlebenszyklus von der Idee bis zum Launch und entwickelst das Sortiment kontinuierlich weiter.

 Du behältst Umsatz, Marge und Wachstum im Blick und triffst deine Priorisierungen datenbasiert.

 Du steuerst regulatorische Anforderungen (Produktsicherheit, Kennzeichnung, Compliance) im Timing gemeinsam mit unserem Regulatory-/QA-Team - die fachliche Tiefe liegt dort, du sorgst für die saubere Umsetzung im Produkt.

 Führung & Zusammenarbeit 

 
 Du führst und entwickelst unser Product Team (6+ Personen) in Köln: fachlich, strategisch und kulturell.

 Du baust das Product Team weiter aus, sodass jede Kategorie (Press-Ons, Gel Strips, Care, Accessories) eigenständig aufgestellt ist.

 

 

 Das bringst du mit 🤝 

 
 Erfahrung: Mind. 5 Jahre im Produktmanagement im Beauty-Bereich, davon idealerweise 2 Jahre in einer Führungsrolle . Du hast Produkte eigenverantwortlich von der Idee bis zum Launch gebracht.

 
 Formulierungs-Know-how: Inhaltsstoff- und Formulierungswissen (INCI, Wirkstoffe, Kompatibilitäten).

 
 Produkt- & Trendgespür: Ausgeprägtes Gespür für Produkt, Branding und Beauty-/Nail-Trends, kombiniert mit echtem Kundenverständnis (Customer First).

 
 Struktur & Datenstärke: Klarheit und datengetriebene Entscheidungsstärke, strategischer Weitblick und Hands-on-Mentalität in einem.

 
 Kommunikationsstärke: Sicher im cross-funktionalen Austausch und mit externen Partnern wie Laboren, Herstellern und Dufthäusern.

 
 Standort: Du wohnst in Köln oder Umgebung und kannst regelmäßig vor Ort beim Team sein.

 Kommunikation: Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

 Regulatory : Sicherheit im regulatorischen Umfeld (EU-Kosmetikverordnung, Claims, Compliance) ist ein großes Plus.

 

 Deine Perspektive 📈 
 Du prägst die Zukunft unserer Produktlandschaft von Grund auf: Mit jedem neuen internationalen Markt skaliert dein Portfolio, während du unsere Strukturen, Prozesse und Teams aktiv aufbaust und bei zentralen Strategie- und Wachstumsentscheidungen direkt am Tisch sitzt.

 🤝 Ein echtes Ownership-Rollenprofil mit viel Vertrauen & Gestaltungsspielraum

 
 🏢 Hybrid: unser Product-Office in Köln plus flexible Remote-Möglichkeit in Deutschland

 Join us and build the future of live entertainment.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Cruise Liners & Port Operations
jobs.description:
At Kpler, we are dedicated to helping our clients navigate complex markets with ease. By simplifying global trade information and providing valuable insights, we empower organisations to make informed decisions in commodities, energy, and maritime sectors. 

 

 Since our founding in 2014, we have focused on delivering top-tier intelligence through user-friendly platforms. Our team of over 850 experts from 69 countries works tirelessly to transform intricate data into actionable strategies, ensuring our clients stay ahead in a dynamic market landscape. Join us to leverage cutting-edge innovation for impactful results and experience unparalleled support on your journey to success. 

 
 

 Kpler is expanding into high-value maritime verticals, with Cruise Liners and Port Operations representing two important opportunities. Both address a common market need: the lack of independent, reliable insights into actual performance, built on observed data rather than published schedules or self-reported information.

 In the cruise sector, operators and analysts often rely on published itineraries rather than actual vessel movements, despite the significant fuel and carbon costs associated with fleet operations. In ports, performance data is often incomplete or self-reported, creating a need for independent benchmarking as berth-level emissions carry increasing financial implications under schemes such as the EU ETS.

 As a Senior Product Manager, Cruise Liners & Port Operations, you will own both products end to end, from strategy and roadmap through to the first release and go-to-market. Working closely with the Lead Product Manager – Maritime & Logistics, you will build two early-stage products in parallel, leveraging Kpler’s network of more than 13,000 AIS receivers and over 10,000 mapped ports and berths.

 For Cruise Liners, you will develop itinerary intelligence for tracked fleets, providing an independent view of actual sailed itineraries, fuel consumption and emissions. For Port Operations, you will build a product focused on port-level vessel activity monitoring, giving port authorities a reliable, live view of activity and performance.

 This is an individual-contributor role for an experienced product professional with a background in maritime, cruise, travel, ports or an adjacent B2B data/SaaS environment. You will need to balance competing priorities across two products, establish trusted data methodologies, engage customers and bring both products to market through a pragmatic, build-and-iterate approach.

 

 Key Responsibilities 
 

 Own the product strategy and roadmap for Cruise Liners and Port Operations, prioritising customer needs and commercial opportunities while making trade-offs between the two products explicit.

 Lead market discovery with cruise operators, port authorities, harbour masters and terminal operators, gathering requirements and translating customer needs into product priorities.

 Drive delivery across both products, maintaining clear roadmaps, delivery cadences and launch plans, with a pragmatic approach focused on launching initial capabilities and iterating based on feedback.

 Establish trusted data and benchmarking methodologies for both products, developing an independent view of cruise itineraries, fuel and emissions, alongside consistent port call-cycle measurement and performance benchmarking.

 Collaborate with Engineering, Data, Sales, Product Marketing and other product teams to align delivery, reuse shared data and emissions capabilities, and develop early data and distribution partnerships.

 Define the Cruise Liners product direction, delivering fleet itinerary intelligence based on live, observed vessel movements that reflects actual sailed journeys rather than published schedules.

 Build the Port Operations product, providing port authorities with a reliable, live view of vessel activity using Kpler’s AIS receiver network and mapped port and berth data.

 Develop product positioning and competitive strategy, identifying opportunities to differentiate Kpler’s independent, first-party observed data from existing cruise analytics and port operations offerings.

 Drive go-to-market execution for both products, working with Product Marketing on positioning, packaging, pricing input and launch planning, and establishing repeatable customer discovery and design partnerships.

 Skills & Experience 

 6–10 years of senior product or commercial experience in maritime data, cruise or travel, ports, or an adjacent B2B data/SaaS business, with a proven track record of delivering products that customers adopt.

 Working fluency in at least one of cruise or port operations, with the ability to develop expertise quickly in the other.

 Direct experience in the cruise or ports industry, with an established network among operators, port authorities and terminals.

 Experience translating customer needs into product strategy and working closely with product and engineering team

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Spotify Connect
jobs.description:

Our mission is to make listening feel effortless, personal, and joyful for billions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints—from our mobile and desktop apps to the smart speakers, TVs, cars, and integrations where Spotify shows up every day. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify.

 We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to make Spotify easier to enjoy across the devices people use every day. You will work in Seamless within Platform & Partner Experience, focusing on Spotify Connect and the experiences that help people find, choose, and control where Spotify plays.

 You will bring together user understanding, product judgment, and technical curiosity to make complex interactions feel effortless. From discovering the right device to keeping an experience consistent as people move through their day, you will help build products people can trust.

 What You'll Do 
 

 Own the product strategy and roadmap for your scope within Spotify Connect, turning the broader Seamless direction into clear priorities.

 Work with research and data colleagues to understand cross-device behavior, identify friction, and define measures of success.

 Partner with engineering and design to deliver intuitive and reliable experiences for discovering devices, controlling playback, and moving between them.

 Balance improvements to everyday usability and reliability with experiments that uncover new value.

 Work across teams and partner-facing functions to manage dependencies and deliver a coherent end-to-end experience.

 Explore opportunities created by richer device understanding and emerging ways of interacting with Spotify, keeping privacy, permissions, and user control central.

 Clearly communicate product choices, progress, and results, and use what you learn to improve the roadmap.

 Who You Are 
 

 You have experience owning and delivering high-quality consumer products, from identifying a problem through launch and iteration.

 You can translate user needs into clear priorities and sustain progress across multiple dependencies.

 You are comfortable working with technically complex products and can connect system behavior to the user experience.

 You can communicate and debate strategic and technical complexity with senior stakeholders.

 You use quantitative and qualitative evidence to make decisions and have experience designing and learning from experiments.

 You care about the details that make a product dependable and easy to use.

 You communicate clearly, collaborate well across disciplines, and are willing to work hands-on.

 You have experience with connected devices, playback, platform products, or cross-device experiences, or an interest in developing your expertise in these areas.

 Where You'll Be 
 

 This role is based in Stockholm or London.

 We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

 Spotify is an equal opportunity employer. You are welcome at Spotify for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or what’s playing in your headphones. So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our differences that we will find the power to keep revolutionizing the way the world listens.

If you need accommodations at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know - we’re here to support you in any way we can.

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager: Product Discovery Engine
jobs.description:
Staff Product Manager, Product Discovery Engine 
 
 About Us 
 Constructor powers product search and discovery for some of the largest retailers in the world. We serve billions of requests every week, and you’ve probably seen our results somewhere and used our product without knowing it. We differentiate ourselves by focusing on metrics over features, and reinventing search and discovery from the ground up as a machine learning challenge with the specific goal of improving metrics like revenue. We’re approximately doubling year over year despite the market slowing down and have customers in every eCommerce vertical. We’re a passionate team of technologists who love solving problems and want to make our customers’ and coworkers’ lives better. We value empathy, openness, curiosity, continuous improvement, and are excited by metrics that matter. We believe that empowering everyone in a company to do what they think is best can lead to great things.
 
 Job Summary 
 We’re looking for a systems-minded Staff Product Manager to take Constructor’s search and discovery to the state of the art — and keep it there — across every retail industry we serve. This is a highly technical, high-leverage role at the core of our Product Discovery Engine chapter: the teams responsible for how we retrieve, understand, and rank the right products for every shopper, on every query, for every customer.
 Your job is to raise discovery quality and, through it, our customers’ business metrics. You won’t be measured on features shipped — you’ll be measured on relevance and business outcomes, like conversion, revenue per visit, and search-attributed GMV, moving up.
 You’ll start embedded with our Search Quality team, owning its strategy and roadmap and getting deep into the systems that decide what shoppers actually see. Over time, your mandate grows to setting direction for the entire Product Discovery Engine chapter — deciding where we’re heading and why across recall, ranking, query understanding, personalization, and the ML infrastructure underneath. This is a Staff role today with a clear path to Director as you take on chapter-wide leadership.
 Search at Constructor is fundamentally a machine learning problem, so this role lives and breathes ML. You’ll partner closely with ML, data science, and engineering to turn the latest research into production wins, keep us ahead of both commercial competitors and academic state of the art, and be the connective tissue that aligns multiple teams — ML Recall, ML Infra, and, over time, teams like CORE, SABR, and Catalog Management — behind a single, coherent vision for great discovery.
 If you’re excited about driving innovation across dozens of the world’s largest retailers, being held to relevance and business outcomes, and pushing an already best-in-class product further ahead, this role is for you.
 
 What You’ll Do 
 Own business impact, not features. Drive measurable lift in search-attributed conversion, revenue per visit, and GMV alongside relevance across our customer base.

 Deliver across every retail industry. Move quality and business metrics across all the verticals we serve, accounting for the differences in catalog, language, and shopper intent.

 Keep us at the state of the art. Continuously translate the latest ML / IR research and competitive moves into production wins, and ship SOTA ML / LLM-assisted capabilities that beat our previous best on relevance.

 Set chapter vision and strategy. Define the multi-quarter direction for the Product Discovery Engine — where we’re heading and why — tie it directly to customer business outcomes, and rally teams behind it.

 Lead Search Quality first. Own its strategy and roadmap, driving measurable improvements in the relevance and correctness of results.

 Orchestrate across the pipeline. Unify recall, ranking, query understanding, and personalization behind one definition of quality and one set of business metrics, so improvements compound instead of colliding.

 Turn ML research into production wins. Partner deeply with ML and data science to take models — from candidate generation and recall to LLM-assisted interpretation — from idea to production, balancing accuracy, latency, and cost.

 Make quality measurable and explainable. Build the metrics, evaluation frameworks, and tooling the whole chapter uses to measure, attribute, and explain discovery quality and its business impact.

 Own quality under pressure. Lead investigation and triage when issues arise, and design durable, systemic fixes rather than one-off patches.

 Grow the mandate. Expand into chapter-wide leadership spanning ML Recall, ML Infra, and — over time — teams like CORE, SABR, and Catalog Management.

 Your Mission
 As Project Manager for Avionics, GNC and Flight Software, you will be responsible for coordinating the execution of these work packages and ensuring that their development remains aligned with the overall Nyx program objectives.
 You will work closely with Avionics, GNC and FSW technical leads, systems engineering, propulsion, mission operations, verification and integration teams. Your role will be to create transparency on scope, schedule, interfaces, risks and decisions, while supporting the teams in delivering robust and well-verified capabilities for the vehicle.

 Practical experience managing plans, milestones, dependencies, risks, actions and technical deliverables.

jobs.title: Data Governance Project Manager
jobs.description:
Notre équipe Data Governance recherche un·e Data Governance Project Manager basé·e à Lille 

Chez Decathlon, nous croyons au pouvoir du sport pour unir et inspirer. 

Notre mission : rendre le sport accessible au plus grand nombre, partout dans le monde. Pour y parvenir, la data est au cœur de notre stratégie, elle guide chaque décision, de la conception du produit à l'expérience client Notre défi ? La rendre gouvernée, sûre et accessible à tous. 

Tu rejoindras le Data Governance Center of Excellence pour transformer nos politiques théoriques en réalités opérationnelles. Ta mission est double : Améliorer les dispositifs de contrôles de la données et garantir la conformité de nos actifs via un framework d’audit robuste. 

TA MISSION : ORGANISER LA STRATEGIE D'AUDIT ET DE CONTRÔLE DE NOS STANDARDS DE GOUVERNANCE

1. Stratégie d’Audit & Compliance

Ton rôle est de mesurer la conformité de l'organisation à nos standards de gouvernance sur l’intégralité de notre scope. 

  • Framework de Contrôle vs Audit : Définir la ligne de démarcation entre le contrôle continu (opérationnel/automatique) et l'audit périodique (stratégique/qualitatif).
  • Industrialisation : Identifier les contrôles éligibles à l’automatisation (ex: intégrité référentielle, fraîcheur via les Data Contracts) et piloter leur mise en œuvre avec les équipes Data Engineering.
  • Audit des "Invisibles" : Concevoir les protocoles(y compris plan d’audit, cartographie des risques et déclenchement de mission ad hoc) d'audit pour les critères non-automatisables (pertinence du dictionnaire de données, qualité des descriptions, respect des processus de classification Privacy), identifier les root cause, les risques et les responsabilités.
  • Gestion des non conformités : Définir la stratégie de suivi des écarts. Tu ne te contentes pas de pointer les problèmes, tu bâtis le framework qui aide les équipes à corriger le tir (scoring, plans d'actions, escalade).

2. Structuration

Tu jouera pleinement ton rôle dans la définition et dans l’amélioration continue de l’operating modèle des audits et des contrôles

  • Mandat : Faire valider le niveau de sponsor et de validation du mandat général et/ou des fiches de mission pour assurer le bon niveau d’engagement des audités. Les décisions devront s’articuler autour du cadre général d’Audit interne de Decathlon
  • Reporting : Communiquer les résultats des travaux et assurer le suivi de la mise en oeuvre des recommandations et, le cas échéant, du processus d’escalade
  • Interactions : Formaliser et faire vivre les rituels et procédures permettant d’optimiser les synergies entre les travaux d’audit et de contrôle et ceux des autres équipes de la gouvernance fédérée (Expertise & projets de CoE en particulier)

CE QUE TU APPORTES

  • Expertise en Gouvernance & Data Architecture : Tu maîtrises les frameworks de référence (DAMA/DMBOK), tu comprends les enjeux des architectures modernes (architecture médaillon, Data Contracts, Data Product) et les formats de structuration de données (YAML/JSON)
  • Culture de l'Audit & de la Conformité : Tu as une solide expérience dans la définition de standards, de normes et de protocoles d'audit. Tu sais distinguer un contrôle opérationnel d'un audit de gouvernance et tu es capable de transformer un constat d'écart en un plan de remédiation pragmatique (KRI/KPI)
  • Leadership d'Influence & Change : Tu es à l’aise dans l'animation de communautés (Data Stewards, Producers). Tu sais vulgariser des sujets complexes, lever les points de friction entre technique et business, et porter une vision de "Gouvernance by design"

CE QUE NOUS T’OFFRONS

  • Un mode de travail Hybride ;
  • Possibilité de travailler dans l'un des bureaux de Decathlon Digital à Lille ou Paris;
  • Matériel fourni en accord avec tes missions et nos engagements sociétaux (Mac ou Windows) ;
  • Une équipe de projet locale au sein d'un réseau mondial (possibilité de carrière internationale) ;
  • Développement des compétences et accompagnement (diversité des projets, certifications techniques dès la première année, formations internes et externes, etc.)
  • Package de rémunération (participation des employés aux actions de l'entreprise, bonus mensuels/trimestriels).

CE QUE NOUS T’OFFRONS

  • Organisation de travail hybride ;
  • Matériel fourni en accord avec tes missions et nos engagements sociétaux (Mac ou Windows)

jobs.title: Senior AI Product Manager
jobs.description:
About 9fin 
 9fin is the AI platform powering global debt markets — the world’s largest asset class at over $145 trillion.
 Debt markets are vast, global, and mission-critical, yet still run on fragmented data, PDFs, and manual workflows. 9fin replaces this broken infrastructure with a single platform that centralises proprietary credit data, deep analysis, and high-value workflows across global markets.
 Today, 9fin powers teams at 300+ blue-chip institutions worldwide, including global banks, asset managers, private equity firms, law firms, and advisors. The business is scaling at exceptional speed, with rapid expansion in the US and best-in-class retention driven by deep workflow adoption.
 We’re at a defining inflection point. With proven product-market fit and strong, global market pull, 9fin is accelerating toward becoming the category-defining platform for debt markets worldwide.

 Our AI product area is growing. We already have two Product Managers working across conversational AI, agentic workflows, and domain-specific automation, and we need a third to expand our capacity as the scope of AI at 9fin accelerates.

This could span new AI-powered features for credit analysts, workflow automation for legal and financial analysis, or expanding our conversational AI into new domains.  Create a collaborative environment for your squad, providing wider context and clear goals so everyone can do their best work

 Work with data scientists and ML engineers to bridge the gap between business needs and the technical capabilities of AI models

 Communicate strategy, initiatives, and progress transparently across the organisation

 Translate complex AI concepts, capabilities, and limitations into language that non-technical stakeholders can act on

 Champion responsible AI practices: transparency in model outputs, bias monitoring, and compliance with client expectations around AI-generated content

 What We're Looking For

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Business Banking
jobs.description:
Senior Product Manager - Business Banking 
 Build with us 
 Businesses deserve better from finance. Less friction, more freedom. Since 2004, Mollie has been on a mission to make payments and money management effortless for every business in Europe.
 Today, more than 250,000 companies trust our all-in-one platform to get paid, manage money and grow on their terms. Simple, scalable and built with real businesses in mind.
 We’re one of Europe’s fastest-growing fintechs, with 900+ Mollies across 12+ locations. Our people make this growth possible. We move fast, build with purpose and care deeply about our customers. Whether you’re solving problems, building market-leading products or exploring how AI can make work smarter, you’ll have the freedom to create and the trust to deliver.
 If you’re ready to grow, shape the future of fintech and join an ambitious, high-performing team, this is the place for you.
 
 Your impact 
 As Senior Product Manager, you'll own a significant part of our Business Banking product, one of the newest and most ambitious areas we're building at Mollie.
 This is a build from scratch opportunity. Mollie's position here is rare: we're a payment service provider with a large, established customer base that is now building a full banking proposition on top of it. That means you get the ambition and pace of building something new, combined with the resources, customers, and best practices of a scaled business. You'll work alongside experienced, passionate product leaders who've done this before.
 You'll lead a cross-functional team across design, product, and data analytics. There are no direct reports in this role, but you'll own the team's day to day performance and make sure things ship on time.
 
 What you'll ship 
 Net-new propositions, not incremental iteration. You're building experiences that don't exist yet.

 Customer-facing product and APIs across the Mollie app (web and native mobile) for business banking customers.

 A banking proposition layered on Mollie's existing payments infrastructure, reaching customers who are already active and engaged.
 

 What you'll bring 
 Experience leading a cross-functional product team in an everyday, hands-on capacity

 Comfort with the full product lifecycle, including early-stage building and scaling

 Ability to operate in a high-ambition, high-resource environment alongside experienced and passionate product leaders from across the industry
 

 Grow your way 
 At Mollie, growth is personal. We believe everyone should have the chance to develop their skills, explore new challenges and shape their career on their own terms.
 In this role, you’ll have the unique opportunity to build a meaningful distribution channel from the ground up. As we expand across Europe, you will grow alongside the product area you own. You’ll get regular feedback and performance reviews to support your development, with fair and transparent salary reviews along the way.
 
 Unlock your full potential and join us to eliminate financial bureaucracy 
 If you're excited by the idea of building what's next, for yourself and for thousands of businesses across Europe.
 Want a peek behind the scenes? Check out what life at Mollie is really like.
 
 AI at Mollie 
 We believe in Always Be Shipping, and AI brings that philosophy to life across every team, every role, every day. AI is core to how we build. It helps us move faster, simplify work and make smarter decisions, creating real impact for the businesses we serve. We're looking for people who are excited to use AI to shape the future of finance with us.

jobs.description:
Contexte : 
 Nous recherchons, pour notre client, un grand groupe télécom, un Product Owner spécialisé en tableaux de bord pour piloter le run et les évolutions de notre patrimoine de dataviz, au service des équipes construction.
 Ce Product Owner garantit que les utilisateurs disposent de tableaux de bord fiables, disponibles et utiles sur l'ensemble de leurs activités : construction, MCO (maintien en conditions opérationnelles) et SAV.

 Vous représenterez également notre collectif et nos façons de travailler auprès de l'équipe DATA IA, et relaierez ses préconisations sur Power BI et Looker Studio.
 Responsabilités clés 
 Votre mission centrale : assurer le run du patrimoine de tableaux de bord (Power BI On Cloud ou Google Looker Studio) et accompagner les salariés sur leurs besoins de data visualisation.

 Maintenir le patrimoine existant

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager - Platform
jobs.description:
We're looking for a Staff Product Manager to take on the hardest problems in the data and integration platform that everything at Nelly runs on: how practice data gets into Nelly from dozens of practice management systems, how partners connect to us, and how that data becomes something every product can depend on. At Staff level, your scope follows the problem, across teams and over time into product-wide questions.
 The problem space: Every Nelly product, from documentation to billing to payments, depends on data that lives in a practice's management system. There are dozens of them, each with its own data model and interfaces. 
 How many practices we can serve, how much of their work we can automate, and how much they trust the result come down to four questions: can we connect, can we read and write deeply enough, is the data any good once it arrives, and can every product and team inside Nelly easily build on it?
 About Nelly 
 We are building the AI-Driven Financial Operating System for European healthcare, solving the biggest challenges for patients and practices. We create what no bank or software platform can handle. Our all-in-one platform transforms chaotic administrative processes into intelligent, automated workflows, from patient care to billing to next-generation payments. Because we truly believe: healthcare should be less about paperwork and more about people.
 Why? Because Europe is facing a massive shortage of medical professionals. And if we don't rethink the way practices work, the system won't be able to keep up. With our Series B funding of over €50 million from world-class investors, we are turning our vision into reality.
 What sets us apart: We work with the best team, which is why we give everything together every day. We believe in Talent Density, because exceptional people make everyone around them better. At Nelly, we move fast and expect everyone to keep up. Stagnation isn’t an option, which is why we invest heavily in growth. AI is an essential part of how we work at Nelly. We expect you to use it every day and give you everything you need to do so. You get trust and ownership and we expect you to speak up, even when it's uncomfortable.
 
 Joining us, you will: 
 Own the strategy, metrics and roadmap for hard data and integration problems, from how data leaves a practice's system, through ingestion and modelling, to the products that rely on it, tied to real practice value and to how Nelly makes money

 Shape how partners connect to Nelly through our External API, so we can serve practices on any system and open new markets beyond Germany

 Define the core data every product relies on: what a patient, an appointment, a treatment plan or an invoice means, who owns it, and how fresh and reliable it is, with GDPR and health-data regulation built in from the start

 Make data and integration quality measurable and visible, and move it, because practices feel a silent failure long before we do

 Hold an end-to-end model of the platform and be a credible partner to engineering on architecture and trade-offs

 
 What you'll bring: 
 Agency. You go after the problems that matter most, including well beyond your immediate scope, rather than waiting for a roadmap to land on your desk

 Comfort in a high-velocity environment. You move fast, make bold but reversible calls, and challenge early and directly, including upward

 Business-outcome orientation. You're genuinely data-driven: you can name the metric each project moves and let evidence, not gut feel, drive prioritisation

 Technical fluency. You reason confidently about APIs, data models, data flows and how systems fit together, and you're a credible partner to senior engineers

 You build with AI. You use AI to move faster: prototyping to pressure-test an idea, taking a first pass on the analysis or the spec yourself, shipping the small things directly, so your time goes to judgment and the decisions that move the product

 7+ years of product management experience
 

 Even better if you have: 
 Built and shipped AI products

 Worked on data platforms or data products

 Built B2B SaaS in healthcare or another regulated industry

 Professional German language knowledge

 
 Our Interview Process: 
 Introduction to Nelly with TA

 Product craft interview with our Product manager

 Case study interview with Director of Product

 Onsite interview with hiring manager and stakeholders

 
 What we offer: 
 The people you get to work with. You will work alongside the brightest minds we could find, on hard problems, as a team. We take on challenges together and we never forget to have fun doing it.

 Room to grow faster than almost anywhere else. New challenges, more scope, real ownership from day one. We trust you to own it and to speak up when something is wrong. Just do not expect to stand still.

 A yearly learning and development budget , plus the coaching, feedback and internal knowledge that actually move you forward. Real investment

jobs.title: Product Manager (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
Description 
 We are seeking a product manager to own the "what" and "why" of our quantum sensing measurement systems. You turn customer and market needs into clear product requirements that engineering can turn into specifications, and you own the roadmap for the QDm product line, starting with QDm.1. You sit between our customers (foundries, IDMs, OSATs and failure analysis labs) and every engineering discipline, and you make sure we build the right product in the right order.
  
  
 Who we are 
 Founded in 2022 as a spin-off of TU Munich, QD leverages quantum sensors to rapidly capture three-dimensional current maps within multi-layer chips. Our strong, international team of over 70, including physicists, engineers, data scientists, and other experts, works side by side with major semiconductor manufacturers, supporting chip debugging and accelerating yield analysis. Backed by top-tier deep tech investors, semiconductor experts, and strategic public programs, we have ensured long-term stability, shifting from breakthrough to scale - and shaping the next chapter in chip testing.
  
 Why join QuantumDiamonds? 
 Picture this: 
 Quantum sensors that see inside the most advanced chips on Earth, right where two frontier fields collide.

 Nobel-Prize physics aimed at real customers with real problems, in production now, not someday.

 Physicists, data scientists, and engineers building side by side, turning deep science into tools the industry actually runs on.

 An international team that runs at hard problems for fun, where knowledge moves fast and so do you.

 Still unsure about why joining us? 
 You'll get to build a company together with a brilliant and welcoming team on a product that has never been done before.

 From Day 1, you'll own your own topics end to end and see the direct impact of your work on how the world sees QuantumDiamonds.

 Our technology is the cutting edge of tomorrow, starting today and not in 10 years.

 You’ll be part of a high-growth company backed by top-tier investors.

 Let’s make the invisible visible! 
  
  
 What will you do 
 Own the product requirements: gather needs from customers, the field, the market, and internal stakeholders (serviceability, modularity and product configuration, manufacturability, and cost targets), and turn them into clear, prioritized, solution-neutral requirements.

 Establish our requirements engineering tooling and workflow: select and set up how we capture, trace, and maintain requirements, from customer need through specification to verification, including change control across releases. This is a foundational task in your first months.

 Own and maintain the QDm.1 roadmap: propose what gets built and in what order, make the trade-offs explicit, and align decisions with the management team.

 Work with the applications team on customer interactions and evaluations with fabs, IDMs, OSATs and failure analysis labs, and translate what you learn into requirements.

 For each requirement, define acceptance criteria from the customer's point of view so it is clear and testable when the need is met, and link them to customer evaluation and qualification plans.

 Align with the Product Development department on scope and timing, and hand solution-neutral requirements into engineering: state the need and the why, and leave the how to the disciplines.

 Support go-to-market: give input on positioning, pricing, launch readiness, and documentation scope together with the applications, operations, and product development teams.

  
 What is expected of you 
 Several years in product management for complex hardware or capital equipment, ideally in semiconductor, metrology, or a comparable deep-tech environment.

 A track record of writing clear product requirements that engineering can actually build from.

 The ability to talk to both customers and engineers and to translate between them.

 Enough technical depth to hold a credible conversation with the people designing the product, across mechanics, optics, electronics/RF, and software.

 Structured prioritization: you make trade-offs explicit and back them with reasoning.

 We hire for demonstrated skill rather than a specific degree; a technical or scientific background is typical. The working language is English.

 Additional experience we value: 
 Semiconductor industry knowledge (fabs, IDMs, OSATs, inspection, metrology, or failure analysis).

 Familiarity with SEMI standards and fab tool integration (for example, S2/S8, E10, SECS/GEM).

 Experience selecting or setting up a requirements management tool (for example, Jama, Polarion, or CodeBeamer).

 A working understanding of quantum sensing, optics, or precision instrumentation.

  
 Our benefits 
 Mission: At QD, we’re driven by more than just building great products - we aim to make a lasting difference. Joining us means contributing to meaningful work that goes beyond business as usual.

 Impact & growth: This is an exciting stage of our journey,

jobs.title: Bid & Project Manager – EU & NATO (H/F)
jobs.description:
About Alta Ares
 
Alta Ares is an air defense Neoprime. We build AI-guided interceptors to counter drones and cruise missiles, along with the software platform that powers them.
 Our customers are NATO-aligned militaries and defense institutions, and our systems are regularly deployed during live exercises and operational demonstrations across Europe, the Middle East, and Asia.
 Founded in 2024, we have grown to 90 people, raised over $60M, and increased revenue 40× this year. We are now entering a new phase of international expansion, industrial scaling, fundraising, and product development.
 Role & Mission 
 NATO agencies & EU programs are investing in counter-drone capability now, and Alta Ares answers a fast-growing flow of their tenders and calls for proposals. As Bid & Project Manager in our EU, NATO & Eastern Flank team, you turn each opportunity into a compliant offer, then into a project delivered on time. Your sales director owns the customer relationship and the commercial strategy; you own the offer and its delivery.
 This is not a one-programme job. You will run several bids and projects at once: a NATO bid, an EU grant proposal, and an RFI can land in the same week, and none of them can slip.
 This is a demanding, high-ownership role. Deadlines do not move, the stakes are real, and the team will rely on you to hold the line. We are looking for someone who wants that responsibility.
 
 Bid Management - from first read to submission 
 Screen and qualify opportunities with your sales director; prepare bid/no-bid decisions with risks, resources, and price on the table

 Break each tender down (NATO IFB or RFQ, EU call, RFP for a Nation through EU-NATO platforms such as NSPA or SAFE joint procurement) into a compliance matrix, a bid plan and clear owners

 Write and assemble the management, technical and compliance volumes with Engineering, Product, Finance and Legal

 Organise the review gates and prepare the final price review with Finance; submit complete, compliant and on time, every time

 Run the clarification rounds and support your sales director in negotiations through to contract signature

 
 NATO & EU Procurement - the rules of the game 
 Master NSPA and NCIA procedures: Source File registration, declarations of eligibility, notifications of intent, IFBs and RFQs, basic ordering agreements and framework contracts

 Run EU grant proposals (European Defence Fund, EDIP): Funding & Tenders portal, consortium building, Part A and Part B, lump-sum budgets

 Track national procurement rules and partners on the Eastern Flank through EU-NATO (Poland, Romania, the Baltic States…), e.g. via NSPA or SAFE joint procurement

 Build and maintain the bid library: company documents, CVs, past performance, standard answers, templates

 
 Project Delivery - from award to acceptance 
 Turn each award into a project: kick-off, plan, milestones, risks, budget and change control

 Coordinate engineering, production, demo and logistics teams, and partners, to deliver what we promised when we promised it

 Own customer reporting, deliverables and acceptance (FAT/SAT), with the documentation trail for invoicing and audits

 Run several projects in parallel, each at a different stage

 
 Process & Reporting 
 Set the bid and project rhythm for the team: calendar, gates, templates, dashboards

 Review the status of every live bid and project weekly with your sales director: deadlines, compliance, risks, resources needed

 Run lessons learned after every bid, won or lost

 
 Candidate Profile 
 5+ years in bid, proposal or project management in defence, aerospace or security

 Proven record of compliant, on-time submissions to NATO agencies, EU programmes or European ministries of defence, several of them in parallel

 At least one defence contract delivered from award to acceptance

 Scale-up or lean-team experience is a significant advantage; prime experience is welcome if you want more breadth and speed

 Skills & Qualities 
 Rigorous and precise compliance is binary; in defence, the margin for error is zero

 Built for parallel work you run several bids and projects at once, prioritise hard and never drop the ball

 Committed you own the outcome, not just your part of it; submission peaks are part of the job and you plan for them

 Calm under pressure fixed deadlines, late amendments and competing requests do not throw you

 A clear writer structured, scoreable English; you turn engineering input into compliant answers

 A leader without authority you get engineers, Finance, Legal and partners to deliver on time

 Technically curious you understand how sensors, effectors, C2 and AI fit together, or you learn it fast

 Discreet and trustworthy you handle sensitive commercial and defence information as a matter of course

 Mission-driven you care about European security, not just the job title

 Nice to Have 
 APMP, Shipley, PMP, PRINCE2 or IPMA certification

 Experience on a European Defence Fund or EDIP consor

jobs.title: Technical Product Lead - AI Stockbroking
jobs.description:
About BJAK 
 The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.
  
 The Role 
 BJAK is building a AI Stockbroking Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.
  
 These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.
  
 The Technical Product Lead owns a product vertical end-to-end , from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.
  
 We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.
  
 What You'll Own 
 Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

 Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

 Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

 Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

 Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

 Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

 Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.
  

 What We're Looking For 
 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

 Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

 Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

 Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

 Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

 Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.
  

 Nice to have 
 Engineering or highly technical product background.

 Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

 Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.
  

 Outcome 
 Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

 Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

 Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

 AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

 Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

 Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction
  

 Location 
 This is a remote role . We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones. 
  
 Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.
  
 Language 
 English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.
  
 Interview Process 
 Our process is designed to move fast:
 Online assessment or practical task

 Technical interview

 CEO / final round

  
 For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Interactive Avatars (Staff/Principal-level)
jobs.description:
Synthesia is the world’s leading AI video platform for business, used by over 90% of the Fortune 100. Founded in 2017, the company is headquartered in London, with offices and teams across Europe and the US. 
 As AI continues to shape the way we live and work, Synthesia develops products to enhance visual communication and enterprise skill development, helping people work better and stay at the center of successful organizations.
 Following our recent Series E funding round, where we raised $200 million, our valuation stands at $4 billion. Our total funding exceeds $530 million from premier investors including Accel, NVentures (Nvidia's VC arm), Kleiner Perkins, GV, and Evantic Capital, alongside the founders and operators of Stripe, Datadog, Miro, and Webflow.
 
 About the role 
 For years, avatars have been something you watch. You write a script, we render a video, someone presses play. That model has taken AI video a long way but it has a ceiling. A video can't answer a question. It can't read the room. It can't role-play a tough conversation and adapt when you push back.
 We're changing that. Interactive Avatars listen, talk, and respond in real time; inside your product, your website, or your internal tools. You bring the logic and the language model; we power the avatar layer: the speech, the expression, the listening, the sense that there's someone actually there.
 It's early. Interactive Avatars is in closed beta today, and the teams building on it are pushing it into places we didn't expect - AI sales reps, always-on support agents, interactive trainers, onboarding guides. We're hiring a Product Manager to own it and take it from beta to a platform that thousands of developers build on.
 This is a role with real scope. You'll help define what a real-time avatar API should be, the surface developers integrate against, the experience end users feel, and the commercial model that makes it a business. You'll work directly with the engineering and research teams building the real-time avatar stack, and with the design partners already live in the beta.
  
 The problem you're solving 
 Today, a developer who wants a lifelike, real-time avatar in their product has to stitch together a streaming pipeline, a rendering layer, an agent, and a set of hard real-time problems - latency, interruption handling, listening behavior, expressiveness, consistency across sessions, most of which have nothing to do with the product they're actually trying to build.
 We have the avatar technology and a working beta. What we need is a PM who can turn that into an API a developer can integrate in an afternoon, trust in production, and build a real business on top of, all while holding a quality bar high enough that the experience feels human, not uncanny.
  
 What you'll be doing 
 Owning the end-to-end Interactive Avatar API. This is the developer-facing surface (SDK, integration patterns, docs), the real-time experience quality, and the path from closed beta to general availability, and defining what the roadmap looks like over the coming cycles

 Getting close to the developers and teams building on the beta: understanding how they integrate, where the API fights them, which real-time behaviors make or break the experience, and what "production-ready" means to them

 Translating that understanding into a clear product direction. What to build, in what order, and why, and keeping the team aligned as the strategy evolves

 Working closely with the engineering and research teams building the real-time avatar stack; contributing clear specs, sound judgment on trade-offs (quality vs. latency vs. cost), and the context that helps them build the right thing the first time

 Partnering with go-to-market and commercial teams to define how the API is packaged, priced, and sold - a real-time API has a fundamentally different business model from batch video, and shaping that is part of the job

 Defining and tracking the metrics that tell us whether the product is working across adoption, integration success, real-time quality, reliability, and the commercial signals that prove it's a business

 Who you are 
 You've owned a developer-facing product before like an API, an SDK, or a platform and you know that the product is the developer experience. You understand that adoption is won or lost in the first hour of integration, and that trust is won or lost the first time something breaks in production. You build accordingly.
 You're comfortable in a space where the roadmap isn't fully formed. You don't need a clean brief to get started. You can talk to developers, watch them integrate, synthesize what you see, and come back with a point of view. You're also honest about what you don't know and willing to update when the evidence changes.
 You care about the detail, and you can hold a quality bar for something subjective and hard: a real-time avatar either feels present and responsive or it feels off, and the difference lives in latency

Location: Paris, France preferred, open to London applicants (hybrid, three days a week in the office)

Contract: Permanent

Please note: This role requires an existing right to work in the EU. We can’t offer visa sponsorship, but we review sponsorship role by role, so keep an eye on our careers site for future opportunities.

About Kaluza

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

With teams across Europe, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.

What you’ll do

  • Own the Roadmap: Lead the end-to-end strategy for Kaluza Agent Experience (KAE) within the European market—grounded in global product goals but sharpened by local client needs and agent behaviors. Driving core operational metrics (AHT, FCR, CSAT, AI adoption, onboarding)ensuring capabilities improve agent/customer outcomes.
  • Drive Journey Design & UX Consistency: Act as guardian of agent UX across KAE to ensure coherence across the experience. Partnering with UX and domain teams to apply shared patterns consistently, reduce agent cognitive load, and maintain alignment and compliance with the design system as new automation and assistive/AI capabilities are introduced.
  • Lead Integrations & Client Onboarding: Drive technical and product integrations with third-party platforms and oversee spinning up new KAE instances end-to-end for incoming clients from discovery through go-live.
  • Ensure Accessibility & Compliance: Champion EU accessibility regulations by design, translating regulatory and market-specific needs into actionable engineering requirements.
  • Engage Clients & Drive Value: Serve as the trusted expert for clients on agent experience, advocating for platform-first configuration over bespoke builds
  • Hands-on Delivery & Enablement: Maintain active involvement across the entire Product Development Life Cycle (PDLC)—from agent discovery sessions to feedback loops—and produce materials to support successful client adoption.

    (Note: Travel to client sites e.g., Brussels, is expected at roughly 1–3 trips a month initially, tapering to 1–2 times a quarter.)

What you’ll bring

Ideally, you’ll have:

  • Contact Centre & UX Expertise: Deep experience owning end-to-end user journeys for high-frequency operational tools (e.g., agent desktops), with hands-on craft in user research, journey mapping, and usability testing with agents and supervisors.
  • EU Accessibility & Platform Integration: Strong working knowledge of EU accessibility standards alongside proven experience integrating products with complex third-party platforms and vendor ecosystems.
  • Client Delivery & Market Expansion: Successful track record implementing or localizing a product for external enterprise clients, taking solutions from zero to live through discovery, configuration, and change management.
  • Data-Informed Judgement & Influence: Demonstrated ability using operational metrics (AHT, FCR, CSAT, agent effort) to defend product decisions, coupled with a platform-first mindset that prioritizes existing capabilities over custom code.
  • Bilingual Capability: Full professional bilingual fluency (written and spoken) in both English and French.

What will set you apart 

  • Experience leveraging AI tools, machine learning capabilities, or LLM integrations within product workflows to enhance platform intelligence and automation directly into customer service desktop envir

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager (Product Development)
jobs.description:
About Us : AI compute is hitting a hard physical wall, and memory bottlenecks are throttling the entire industry. Founded in October 2024 and backed by €57M in funding, Vertical Compute is solving this with proprietary Vertical Integrated Memory (VIM™) chiplets, making AI hardware faster, greener, and vastly more scalable. We are an interdisciplinary team transforming breakthrough semiconductor physics into commercial reality. 
 
 Why Now : After 18 months of intensive R&D, Vertical Compute has reached a critical inflection point. Our underlying technology is validated, and we have successfully met our core technical milestones. Armed with a proven technical data package and ongoing system studies, we are now shifting from pure R&D to active engagement with global enterprise customers. As we prepare for our next phase of scale and growth starting in 2027, joining us today means taking direct ownership of the hardware foundation that will power the next era of AI compute. 
 
 About the role: 
 You will oversee key technical initiatives to deliver our unified hardware and software platform. You will play a crucial role in transitioning products from initial development into commercial production. Taking full ownership of execution, you will bridge technology delivery with strategic commercial goals. 

 Key responsibilities: 
 Own the cross-functional execution framework for complex silicon and software development programs from early architecture through tapeout, post-silicon bring-up, and release. 

 Partner closely with hardware, software, architecture, and product teams to drive alignment on milestones, roadmaps, and execution reviews. 

 Establish scalable execution practices, manage program dependencies, and proactively mitigate risks across hardware and software integration efforts. 

 Manage cross-functional dependencies and program delivery flow to ensure seamless execution. 

 Drive regular program-level product demonstrations to validate milestones and gather stakeholder feedback. 

 Lead continuous improvement initiatives to refine operational processes and team coordination. 

 Proactively identify and resolve architectural or organizational blockers, managing risk and maintaining relentless progress from initial exploration to customer acceptance. 

 Identify execution risks, lead risk mitigation plans, and drive trade-off decisions across scope, schedule, resources, and quality 

 About the team: 
 This role is part of the operations team, partnering closely with our cross-functional engineering teams in System & Product and Memory Design. We foster a highly collaborative, inclusive environment where strong alignment, high transparency and seamless team coordination are central to our shared success. 
 
 
 
 About who you are: 
 Masters or higher in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Physics or a related technical field. Ability to understand the system and the sub-systems. 

 Strong technical foundation in hardware design, memory architecture, advanced packaging, chiplets, and AI acceleration technologies. 

 Proven track record in technical program management within the semiconductor industry, with experience delivering complex products that integrate novel hardware with firmware. 

 Data-driven; actively leveraging AI tools in daily workflows. 

 Relentless Improvement Mindset. 

 Adaptive and servant leadership style and problem-solving fluency in a cross-functional organization working on complex hardware-software integration. 

 Fluency in English with strong written and verbal communication abilities. 

 
 
 Location : Leuven (Belgium) / Grenoble (France) / Remote. Regular travel is expected to support effective and efficient collaboration and keep pace with our rapid growth.

 Our mission 
 We turn data into better healthcare. With our insights, we make healthcare more affordable and better, and we improve the patients' and clinicians' experience.
 
 Your impact 
 Dutch clinical registries are among the richest sources of outcome data in Europe. At LOGEX, that data reaches clinicians and hospitals through applications such as Codman and Data Entry, and reaches researchers and healthcare professionals through data requests and exports. As Senior Product Owner you own that portfolio end to end: the applications that clinicians use every day, and the data pipelines that power them.
 You are the product owner for our largest registry partner and decide what gets built within a fixed capacity. You also make sure that what we build strengthens the wider LOGEX platform wherever possible.
 
 What you'll own 
 Applications: user-facing applications for manual data entry, dashboarding and exports – owning the roadmap, priorities and release quality.

 Pipelines and business logic: registry processing (merge, load, curation), data exports, scientific data requests, data linkage and registry development sets.

 One backlog, two types of developers: you lead the product work of a team that combines data engineers with back-end and front-end developers. You translate user and partner’s needs into work for both, and you see early where a front-end change depends on a pipeline change.

 Prioritisation within fixed capacity: you align with one counterpart at our largest registry partner on what gets built and when, with transparent trade-offs, realistic yearly planning and a clear path to extra capacity when it is funded.

 Reusable by design: you turn partner-specific needs into shared LOGEX components wherever possible, in close collaboration with other Product Owners and Product Managers.

 Regulatory and standards readiness: you make sure the products keep meeting healthcare regulation and move along with open data standards, e.g. FHIR.

 Run and improve: you balance new development with maintenance and technical debt, and you help to reduce key-person risk in a small team.

 Customer-facing: you work closely with the Customer Office on scope, project proposals and delivery expectations, and you represent the products in partner and user sessions.

 
 What you bring 
 At least 5 years of experience as product owner or product manager

 Experience working with a team of mixed engineering profiles

 Experience managing a demanding, influential stakeholder or key client

 Fluent in Dutch and English, spoken and written

 A laptop and everything you need to set up a comfortable and ergonomic home office

 Personal and professional development opportunities through our LOGEX Academy

 Access to our mental health partner, OpenUp

 Regular after-work drinks and many more social events

 Do you want to play a key role in developing next-generation solutions for partners recognized as international leaders in clean and autonomous mobility?
 
 If so, we want you on our team as our new Senior Project Manager!
 
 Who we are 
 We are a fast-growing high-tech company with a clear mission: accelerating the transition to sustainable mobility through hands-free charging technology.
 By combining soft robotics, computer vision, and software, we build reliable solutions that make fleet electrification easier and more scalable.
 
 We are a global organization, headquartered in Rijswijk, the Netherlands, with a U.S. office in Portland, OR.
 
 Together, we are building a cleaner future.
 
 You make the difference 
 
 As a Senior Project Manager at Rocsys, you will direct the execution of technically complex product development projects from concept to deployment. You will serve as the central connector between Product Management, Product Development (R&D), Supply Chain, and Customer Success.
 
 What makes this role impactful is your ability to coordinate complex project delivery across two distinct axes:
 
 Multidisciplinary R&D Execution: You synchronize highly diverse engineering tracks—including hardware, electronics, embedded/cloud software, computer vision, AI, and robotics—to ensure integrated system delivery.

 Cross-Departmental Alignment: Rather than defining requirements or architecture, you own the execution bridge. You translate Product Management’s strategic roadmap into R&D milestones, and manage the operational handover to Manufacturing, Sourcing, and Service.
 

 Your core focus remains on tracking the critical path, keeping timelines rigid, and safeguarding quality and cost boundaries.
 
 In this role you will 
 
 Drive Multidisciplinary Engineering Execution 
 Collaborate closely with and align engineers across a wide variety of technical disciplines: system engineering, hardware design, electronics, embedded software, cloud applications, computer vision, AI, and robotics.

 
 Manage End-to-End NPI Projects 
 Lead complex product development cycles.

 Relentlessly manage project schedules, proactively tracking dependencies and safeguarding the critical path and scope.

 
 Support Cross-Functional Collaboration

 Communicating technical engineering status updates for high-level strategic alignment with product management and executives.

 
 What you will bring into Rocsys 
 
 Your knowledge and experience : 
 A completed Master’s or Bachelor’s degree in a highly technical field or Business Administration with an affinity with deep-tech.

 A minimum of 5 years of proven experience as a project manager within a high-tech, complex product development or R&D environment.

 Demonstrated track record of successfully delivering complex hardware-software integrated products.

 A technical foundation allowing you to think critically at a systems level and engage constructively with domain experts across technical disciplines.

 Clear and concise communication skills.

 Willing to travel occasionally to support key validation or deployment phases.

 Experience working within an international technical organization.

About Welo Global 

 Welo Global is a leader in multilingual AI, technology, and content solutions serving over 2,000 clients in 300 languages.  We are seeking an experienced English into German (Switzerland) Review Lead to serve as the language quality owner and primary client-facing linguistic expert for a leading global technology client.

You will be the main point of contact for the client’s Language Manager on quality discussions, arbitration, and escalations, and you will drive consistency, quality governance, and continuous improvement across UI, marketing, product, informational, legal, and support content.

 What You Will Do 

 -Analyse requirements: Review every style guide and glossary update, assess which quality categories and content types it affects, and record the changes. Track what the client’s Language Manager actually corrects and says in calibration and quality calls, not only what is written down.
 -Relay expectations: Run regular alignment roundtables with the language community and publish a structured monthly quality digest covering performance, priority improvement areas, style guide updates, and notable errors and arbitration outcomes.
 -Manage review quality actively: Coach Reviewers one-to-one using specific examples, run shadowing sessions, and deliver training built from real alignment data.
 -Improve the standard: Turn recurring justification patterns into well-reasoned style guide proposals, and share cross-locale patterns with the Welocalize Quality Manager.
 -Maintain alignment with the client: Treat Language Manager decisions as the standard, raise concerns with evidence at the right forum, and aim for fewer surprises over time. 

 What You Will Own 

 -The locale’s review service score, including RQE audit and alignment performance
-The community’s shared understanding of quality 
-The integrity of the arbitration record, ensuring that every arbitration sent to the client is valid and well-evidenced
-The working relationship with the client’s Language Manager, including clarifications, escalations, and expectation tracking 
 

 
 
 Requirements

- Client and stakeholder management: Direct experience as the primary point of contact for client Language Managers, managing formal arbitration or escalation processes, and facilitating conflict resolution 
- Quality audit frameworks: Deep, practical experience with localization evaluation frameworks, including RQE, LQE, error rubrics, and severity mapping 
- Style guide and expectation analysis: Ability to analyse style guide changes, identify implicit client expectations, and map tolerance by content type (for example, Marketing vs. Legal vs. UI) 
- Meeting facilitation: Hands-on experience with one-to-one coaching, shadowing sessions, alignment roundtables, and structured monthly quality reporting 
- Analytical approach: Skill in tracking error concentrations, severity drift, and alignment scores, and in converting justification patterns into style guide improvements 
- Language: Native-level German (Switzerland) and professional-level English
- Preferred: Prior e xperience supporting major technology localization programs and working with calibration or alignment tools

jobs.title: Product Lead 100%
jobs.description:
Unsere Mission 
 Photovoltaik wirtschaftlich, einfach und sorglos machen. Wir bringen die Energiewende ins Gebäude – mit intelligenten Lösungen für Eigenverbrauch & Elektromobilität, die sich für alle lohnen: Investor:innen, Nutzer:innen und unsere Zukunft.
 Als ZEV-Pionierin ist Smart Energy Link heute die führende Schweizer B2B-Plattform für Abrechnung und intelligente Steuerung dezentraler Energieinfrastruktur. Mit einem Team von rund 35 Mitarbeitenden haben wir bereits über 700 Projekte erfolgreich realisiert und betreuen mehr als 20'000 Wohneinheiten im Bereich ZEV und Metering.
 Deine Rolle 
 SEL wächst vom Start-up zum Scale-up – und du gestaltest unsere Produkte in dieser Phase aktiv mit. Als Product Lead verantwortest du unsere Webportale inklusive der Abrechnungslösung und treibst die Produktstrategie gemeinsam mit dem CEO, dem UX-Team und der Entwicklung voran. Du denkst strategisch, führst die Product Discovery und packst bei der Umsetzung mit an – kurze Wege, schnelle Entscheide, echter Gestaltungsspielraum.
 Du verantwortest den wirtschaftlichen Erfolg deiner Produkte, inklusive Preisgestaltung und Markteinführung.

 Du übersetzt Kunden- und Marktbedürfnisse in eine klare Produkt-Roadmap – im Rahmen der regulatorischen Vorgaben (ZEV/vZEV/LEG).

 Du entwickelst unsere Webportale zu einer skalierbaren Plattform weiter und verantwortest die Produkt-Vision, -Strategie und -Roadmap.

 Du sorgst für die marktgerechte Weiterentwicklung der Abrechnungslösung.

 Das bringst du mit 
 Du hast mehrjährige Erfahrung im Produktmanagement von B2B-SaaS-Plattformen, mit agilen Entwicklungsmethoden und in der Skalierung. Technische Konzepte verstehst du so gut, dass du mit der Entwicklung auf Augenhöhe diskutieren kannst.

 Du bringst Erfahrung in Abrechnungs- und Inkassoprozessen mit, idealerweise in einem ZEV- (vZEV, LEG) Umfeld.

 Du kennst die Stromtarifmodelle im europäischen Raum und die regulatorischen Rahmenbedingungen der Schweiz (Energiewirtschaft).

 Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch und Englisch und nutzt beide Sprachen im Alltag

 Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich und teamorientiert

 Du hast eine hohe KI-Affinität.

 Schön, aber kein Muss: 
 Erfahrung mit Elektromobilität oder Smart Grid · Erfahrung in der fachlichen Führung interdisziplinärer Teams · technischer Studienabschluss (z. B. Informatik, Elektro-/Energietechnik) oder gleichwertige praktische Erfahrung.
 Was wir bieten: 
 Bei SEL arbeitest du an etwas, das zählt: Du prägst die Zukunft des Schweizer Energiesektors mit – Tag für Tag.
 Bring dich ein und gestalte die Firma aktiv mit - inkl. Mitarbeiterbeteiligung.

 Wir fördern dein Lernen & Wachstum und beteiligen uns an Kursen, Aus- und Weiterbildungen.

 Wir leben Flexibilität: Du gestaltest deinen Arbeitsalltag weitgehend selbst 

 Wir arbeiten mit Jahresarbeitszeit und einer 40-Stunden-Woche.

 plus: NIKIN-Hoodie, Füürabe-Aareschwumm und Glace im Gfrüürfach

 Wir sind ein agiles Team, das sich gegenseitig schätzt, fordert und weiterbringt – offen, direkt und auf Augenhöhe. Wenn du Lust hast, wirklich etwas zu bewegen: Werde Energiepionier:in bei SEL.
 So geht's weiter 
 Bewirb dich direkt – wir melden uns innerhalb weniger Tage bei dir. Unser Prozess: ein kurzes Kennenlerngespräch per Telefon oder Video, ein ausführliches Interview vor Ort oder remote und ein Schnuppertag, an dem du unser Team und unsere Arbeitsweise hautnah erlebst. Wir freuen uns, von dir zu hören.
