jobs.title: Director of Product Management and IT Operations
jobs.description:
About Self Bill Pro: 
 Self Bill Pro is a rapidly growing startup dedicated to solving one of the most persistent challenges in the employee benefits ecosystem: the complexity of monthly benefits billing. We provide a tech-enabled service where our dedicated team leverages proprietary software to eliminate the administrative burdens of manual invoice audits and costly billing errors. Our mission is to streamline this critical operation, freeing up employers, brokers, and carriers to focus on their strategic priorities. 
 
 About the Role: Compensation - $130,000 - 160,000
 We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Director of Product Management and IT Operations to lead the strategic direction and operational execution of our proprietary software platform. This is a critical leadership role that requires a unique blend of product management expertise, technical acumen, and operational leadership. You will be responsible for defining and driving the product roadmap while also ensuring the stability and security of our IT infrastructure and systems. 
 Reports to: Chief Operating Officer 
 Key Responsibilities: 
 Product Leadership: Partner with our global product manager to define, prioritize, and manage the product roadmap, ensuring it aligns with overall business objectives and our long-term technology vision. 

 Product Development: Lead the product development lifecycle from ideation to launch, including gathering and analyzing user feedback, writing detailed user stories and specifications, and collaborating with our offshore software development team. 

 Technical Oversight: Provide technical oversight and guidance to the development team on product features, enhancements, and operational issues. 

 Compliance & Security: Ensure compliance with security standards (e.g., SOC 2, HIPAA) and best practices, working to protect the organizationâs data and systems. 

 Stakeholder Management: Effectively communicate with and manage relationships with various stakeholders, including customers, investors, and internal teams to gather requirements, test ideas, and communicate product progress. 

 Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with the stateside operational team to field feedback and translate business needs into technical requirements. 

 IT Operations & Helpdesk: Oversee day-to-day IT operations, including helpdesk support and quick resolution of operational issues and hotfixes as new employees are onboarded. 

 
 Extensive experience in a product management role, with a strong background in software development and project management. 

 Direct experience in the employee benefits or benefits administration technology space is a must. 

 Proven ability to think creatively about building software solutions and features that solve complex, real-world problems. 

 Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 

 Experience managing and collaborating with a global or offshore development team. 

 Practical knowledge of IT operations, helpdesk support, and cybersecurity principles. 

 Familiarity with SOC 2 and HIPAA compliance requirements is highly desirable. 

 A natural leader with the ability to inspire and motivate a team, foster a positive work environment, and manage a high-volume workload in a fast-paced environment. 

 Why Join Us? At Self Bill Pro, youâll join a collaborative and ambitious team dedicated to transforming outdated processes through smart, scalable technology. As a key leader in a rapidly growing organization, you will have a direct impact on our product, our clients, and our future. If you are a highly motivated individual with a passion for technology, data, and making a tangible difference in the employee benefits landscape, we encourage you to apply! 
 Equal Opportunity Self Bill Pro is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees, and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other legally protected status.

jobs.title: Senior MarTech Product Manager (d/f/m)
jobs.description:
Our story:
 Every year millions of people are either filing their taxes in fear or giving up on their tax refund altogether. We're working on fixing that. Our intuitive app enables anyone, regardless of education or background, to file their taxes with newfound confidence.
 
 Spread across Germany, Spain and the UK, the team at Taxfix Group with its brands Taxfix and Steuerbot, is a compassionate group of solution-finders. We speak our minds openly, and with over 400 professionals, including tax experts, developers, and IT security experts, we're rich in ideas and voices. The group has facilitated more than 3.5 billion euros in tax refunds for its customers since its founding in 2016.

 Role summary
 You own the marketing-technology layer behind Taxfix's growth: the conversion signals that tell ad networks who converted, the customer data that powers CRM, the consent flows that decide what we may share and with whom, and the referral program, one of the growth mechanics the team owns end to end. This is a senior individual-contributor role with no direct reports. You set direction for a small engineering team (a tech lead plus 3–4 engineers, two-week sprints) that supports four products across three markets, with Paid Acquisition, CRM, Brand and Creative as internal customers. A typical week mixes debugging a missing ad-network event, scoping a referral reward, settling a data-sharing question with Legal, and explaining trade-offs to leadership. All work, including across markets, happens in English; German is not required.
 
 What you'll do
 Own conversion-signal engineering for paid acquisition: client-side and server-to-server events into Singular, Firebase/GA4, Google Ads and TikTok, including synthetic events, revenue values and predicted-LTV signals.

 Run the referral program as a product: reward mechanics, eligibility and fraud rules, voucher infrastructure (Voucherify), the in-app voucher wallet, entry points, and the experiments that tune them.

 Grow push and marketing-consent opt-in through permission primers, iOS/Android OS permission flows and notification preferences.

 Keep CRM data trustworthy: Braze attributes and events, Snowflake-to-Braze syncs, event-loss monitoring, and moving legacy messaging (SendGrid, Firebase) onto Braze.

 Turn consent and privacy requirements into product behaviour, and work with Legal on what data can go to which partner.

 Adapt tracking, CRM attributes and attribution to company launches, such as new subscription pricing tiers, without breaking downstream campaigns or reporting.

 Turn stakeholder requests, support escalations and spike findings into tickets engineers can start on, and decide what goes into the sprint.

 Weigh roadmap work against platform upkeep: pipeline migrations, security fixes, end-of-life SDKs.

 Design A/B tests (Eppo) and read the results for marketing and consent opt-s, and referral changes.

 Report progress, risks and trade-offs in writing to marketing leadership, including VP and C-level.

 
 Must-have skills and experience
 Several years as a product manager owning martech, growth infrastructure or data products, setting your own roadmap with senior stakeholders.

 Hands-on mobile and web attribution: an MMP (Singular or comparable), server-to-server events, and ad-network conversion setups (Google Ads, TikTok).

 Event-tracking depth: you can define an event schema, write a tracking spec, and trace a missing or duplicated event through Segment, Google Tag Manager and the receiving platform.

 CRM data platforms, ideally Braze: custom attributes, event-triggered segmentation, data ingestion and sync quality.

 Working knowledge of EU consent and privacy: GDPR, consent mode, iOS App Tracking Transparency, and how push permissions behave on iOS and Android.

 Experimentation: framing hypotheses, choosing and configuring metrics, judging when a result is real.

 Precise writing: specs that engineers (and AI coding agents) can start on without a meeting, and concise updates and decision memos for leadership.

 Enough technical fluency to work through trade-offs with engineers across mobile apps (React Native), backend services and data pipelines, and to triage production incidents.

 
 Nice to have
 Performance marketing experience with the main app and web acquisition channels (e.g. Google Ads, TikTok).

 Referral, loyalty or voucher programs; Voucherify specifically.

 Predicted-LTV or value-based bidding signals (e.g. Churney).

 Deep linking and deferred deep linking across ad networks.

 AI-driven CRM orchestration (Aampe) or creative asset tooling (Frontify, AI creative tagging).

 Building AI agents or automation for product and engineering workflows.

 Querying data yourself in SQL (Snowflake), and familiarity with dbt and Airflow.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
We pull medical technology from the future to solve human health. 
  
 Scarlet is authorised to assess and certify medical devices. We combine clinical, technical and regulatory expertise with AI agents and software so rigorous certification can keep pace with product development at the world’s most ambitious technology companies, without lowering the safety bar.
 Our customers have cut a year or more from their certification timelines for new AI-enabled medical devices and shortened product-update cycles from months to weeks. You’ll join a team building the infrastructure that makes these outcomes repeatable at scale.
  
 About the role 
 As a Product Manager at Scarlet, you will own a meaningful product area end to end. You will develop a deep understanding of the people and problems within it, set a clear direction, decide what matters most, and work with product design and engineering to deliver measurable improvements.
 You will sit close to regulatory experts, account managers and customers in our London office. Their expertise will give you rich signals, but not a ready-made roadmap. Your job is to turn those signals into a coherent product strategy, make trade-offs openly and ensure what we build improves both the quality and speed of certification.
 You will have substantial autonomy. We will trust you to form a point of view, test it against evidence and change course when the evidence changes.
  
 Responsibilities 
 Own the strategy, roadmap and outcomes for a product area, from discovery and definition through launch, adoption and iteration.

 Partner closely with product design, engineering and regulatory experts to turn complex requirements into clear, trustworthy workflows.

 Spend time with customers and internal users to understand their work, observe friction and distinguish underlying problems from requested features.

 Prioritise across customer value, regulatory rigour, operational efficiency, technical constraints and Scarlet’s company goals.

 Keep the team aligned on the problem, the intended outcome and the trade-offs behind each decision.

 Communicate product direction, decisions, progress and learning clearly across Scarlet.

 Help improve how Scarlet practises product management as the team grows.

  
 Required qualifications 
 Evidence of owning and shipping complex products from discovery through delivery and iteration.

 Strong product judgement, including examples of difficult prioritisation choices made under real constraints.

 Enough technical fluency to work effectively with engineers on systems, data, APIs and the trade-offs of AI-enabled products.

 Clear, precise written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain complex decisions to different audiences.

 Comfort working in ambiguity, taking responsibility and updating your view when new evidence appears.

 High standards for product quality, reliability and trust.

  
 Preferred qualifications 
 Experience in health technology, enterprise software, vertical SaaS or another regulated industry.

 Experience building products for complex, multi-stakeholder or expert-led workflows.

 Experience with AI-enabled products, including evaluation, failure modes and appropriate guardrails.

 Experience in an early-stage or fast-growing company where product practices were still being formed.

  
 Interview process 
 We typically collapse steps 3 to 5 into one in-person session.
 Intro chat with Johnny - 30 minutes

 Engineering and design chats with Niclas and Jono - 30 minutes each

 Problem solving session with a member of tech ops - 30 minutes

 Interview with Johnny - 30 minutes

 Culture interviews with the founders Jamie and James - 30 minutes each

 References and offer. 

  
 Application note 
 You do not need to meet every preferred qualification to apply. We are interested in the quality of your judgement, the outcomes you have helped create and the way you learn. If this role excites you and your experience has taken a different route, we would still like to hear from you.
 Compensation: £70K – £100K • Offers Equity

About us 

Riverlane’s mission is to master quantum error correction (QEC) and unlock a new age of human progress. From advances in material and climate science, to complex chemistry simulation for new drug design, quantum computers will help humanity solve some of its most important challenges. But without QEC, the industry’s defining technical challenge, such breakthroughs can never be achieved. Riverlane is the world leader in QEC technology.  It’s a complex problem that requires a range of skills, talent and passion.  

Having raised more than $125M in funding to date to accelerate our cutting-edge R&D in quantum error correction (QEC), Riverlane partners with many of the world’s leading quantum hardware providers and governments to make fault-tolerant quantum computing a reality. We’re making remarkable progress and growing fast

We are looking for an exceptional Product Marketing Manager to lead the positioning, messaging, and go-to-market strategy for Deltaflow, our real-time quantum error correction (QEC) system. Deltaflow is a critical component in the quantum computing stack, enabling the ultra-fast data processing and decoding required to correct errors in quantum computers in real time with high accuracy and throughput.

What we need

  • A collaborative, cross-functional team player, in line with our company values
  • Thrives in a fast-moving, rapidly evolving, self-empowering culture
  • Excellent written and spoken English

Even better if…

 People assume the supply chain is an automated, algorithmic system. In reality, hundred of thousands of operators acting as the glue between organisations and systems, doing work the world depends on, with tools that have barely changed in decades and spending hours a day on email. Nexcade is building the agentic operating system for those people, transforming the way people communicate and optimise the $1T spend on logistics every year.
 Our agents are live in production with leading global Freight Forwarders, pricing millions in freight every week, and we are rapidly expanding the platform to touch every part of the logistics lifecycle.
 Our founders, Dan and Tasho, spent years at Sedna and Palantir working with supply chain companies on problems like this one. We have raised $8.5M to make this a reality from top VCs and angels who backed or founded Synthesia, n8n and other world-class companies.
 How we work
 Everybody builds, founders included. The whole company is technical and runs on coding agents. You will not be asked to write production software, but you will use agents for discovery synthesis, specs, prototypes and data analysis rather than doing them by hand.

 Closely with customers and design partners, so what we ship changes how they operate.

 At pace. Fast cycles and quick iterations, on the product and on how we work.

 End to end. If you see something broken or missing, you have the freedom (and the responsibility) to fix it.

 In person, in London. We value synchronous communication.

 Debate rigorously, decide quickly, execute relentlessly.

 Enjoy the journey. Hard problems, good colleagues.

 We’re building the AI platform freight forwarders rely on. We started with quoting and are expanding across the shipment lifecycle. As Product Lead, you will be central to that expansion, helping decide where we focus and turning those decisions into products customers depend on.
 What you’ll do: 
 Own product outcomes: Own the roadmap, priorities and performance of specific products, from defining the customer problem through launch, rollout and adoption. Partner with the founders on overall product direction and strategy.

 Build from customer insight: Work closely with freight forwarders across commercial and operational roles. Understand how they work, identify the problems customers share and build products for those needs rather than one-off solutions.

 Prototype and build: Turn ideas into working prototypes and early product versions, using AI tools and code to test them with customers. Work hands-on with engineering to take promising ideas into production, not just write specs and hand them over.

 Drive product expansion: Build a clear view of the market, including where we win, where we do not compete and why customers choose us. Use that understanding to identify the next workflows Nexcade should enter and turn them into products that grow revenue.

 Raise the standard of product thinking: Define success measures, test assumptions and examine accuracy, edge cases and second-order effects before scaling. Write clear specs and decision documents, including a written recommendation on the hard calls.

 Build the product operating system: Establish a clear planning and decision-making cadence without adding bureaucracy. Make sure product meetings are well prepared, teams have the context they need and decisions translate into shipped work.

 Make product and platform trade-offs: Work closely with engineering to decide when to invest in shared capabilities and when a faster, product-specific approach is right.

 What we look for 
 Strong product judgement: You have owned meaningful product work in a complex B2B product and can show how your decisions changed customer behaviour or business results. You define success clearly and test assumptions, accuracy and edge cases before scaling.

 Product taste: You can turn complex workflows into products that feel simple, coherent and trustworthy. You care about the details that make people choose to use them.

 Technical fluency: You work effectively with strong engineers, understand trade-offs across architecture, AI, data and integrations and bring the customer and product perspective to choices about speed, quality and reuse.

 Excellent judgement: You get beyond what customers ask for to understand how their work really happens and distinguish repeatable needs from bespoke requests. You use customer and market insight to make product choices that drive adoption, expansion and revenue.

 High agency and directness: You take ownership, hold a high bar and disagree openly and constructively. You are comfortable with ambiguity, fast iteration and changing priorities.

 Obsess over the problem: You are drawn to complex, messy problems in industries the economy depends on and want to understand how the people and systems behind them really work. Industry experience is a bonus, but not required.

 The biggest product ch

jobs.title: Customer Project Manager/-in / Projektleiter/-in (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Für unseren Standort Langgöns suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt eine engagierte Persönlichkeit mit Gestaltungswillen und Organisationstalent als
 Customer Project Manager/-in / Projektleiter/-in (m/w/d) 
 Vollzeit 40 Stunden/ Woche - unbefristet
 Gestalten Sie komplexe Kundenprojekte zum Erfolg 
 Sie möchten anspruchsvolle Kundenprojekte eigenverantwortlich steuern und dabei technische Exzellenz, Kundenorientierung und wirtschaftlichen Erfolg miteinander verbinden? Dann werden Sie Teil unseres Teams.
 Als Customer Project Manager / Projektleiter (m/w/d) übernehmen Sie die Gesamtverantwortung für nationale und internationale Kundenprojekte und begleiten diese von der Auftragserteilung bis zur erfolgreichen Übergabe an den Kunden. Dabei agieren Sie als zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen unseren Kunden und den internen Fachbereichen.
 Aufgaben
 Sie übernehmen die Leitung und Steuerung von Kundenprojekten während der Leistungserstellung über die Auftragserteilung im Produktionswerk bis zur Übergabe an den Kunden.

 Sie verantworten die Einhaltung von Terminen, Budgets und Kundenanforderungen. Inklusive Vor-Und Nachkalkulationen.

 Sie koordinieren interdisziplinäre Projektteams und sorgen für eine zielgerichtete Zusammenarbeit aller Beteiligten.

 Sie identifizieren Projektrisiken frühzeitig und entwickeln geeignete Maßnahmen zur Sicherstellung des Projekterfolgs.

 Sie begleiten technische Klärungen und unterstützen den Vertrieb bei komplexen Kundenanfragen.

 Sie koordinieren Änderungsanforderungen und stellen eine transparente Kommunikation gegenüber Kunden und internen Stakeholdern sicher.

 Sie organisieren Kundenabnahmen und begleiten die erfolgreiche Umsetzung bis zur Inbetriebnahme.

 Sie dokumentieren Projektfortschritte und leiten Optimierungspotenziale für zukünftige Projekte ab.

 Das bringen Sie mit 
 Abgeschlossenes Studium der Fachrichtung Maschinenbau, Mechatronik, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder eine vergleichbare technische Qualifikation.

 Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Projektmanagement, idealerweise im Maschinen- oder Anlagenbau.

 Ausgeprägtes technisches Verständnis sowie ein gutes Gespür für wirtschaftliche Zusammenhänge.

 Strukturierte, eigenverantwortliche und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise.

 Kommunikationsstärke, Verhandlungsgeschick und sicheres Auftreten gegenüber Kunden und internen Ansprechpartnern.

 Hohe Kundenorientierung sowie die Fähigkeit, auch komplexe Sachverhalte verständlich zu vermitteln.

 Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

 Sicherer Umgang mit Projektmanagement Tools, ERP-Systemen und den gängigen MS-Office-Anwendungen.

 Unsere Benefits auf einen Blick 
 Verantwortungsvolle Position mit viel Gestaltungsspielraum und spannenden nationalen sowie internationalen Projekten

 Kollegiales Arbeitsumfeld mit flachen Hierarchien und kurzen Entscheidungswegen

 Attraktive Vergütung sowie umfangreiche Sozialleistungen

 Umfassende Weiterbildungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten

 Betriebliche Altersvorsorge und Bike-Leasing

 Du verantwortest die eigenständige Erstellung, Kalkulation und Verhandlung individueller Angebote für Bestands- und Neukunden.
 Du entwickelst individuelle Konzepte und Präsentationen zur Akquise und Gewinnung neuer Kunden und Sponsoren.

 Du begleitest relevante Kundenveranstaltungen und Termine und stellst gemeinsam mit den beteiligten Partnern eine professionelle Umsetzung sicher.
 Du erstellst aussagekräftige Reportings für Kunden und Sponsoren.
 Du behältst Termine, Budgets, Leistungen und Projektfortschritte im Blick und sorgst für eine strukturierte Umsetzung der Projekte.

 Du verfügst über Berufserfahrung im Projektmanagement, Account Management oder Sales im Medienumfeld oder in einem vergleichbaren Bereich.
 Du hast Erfahrung in der Betreuung von Kunden und der eigenständigen Steuerung von Projekten.
 Du bist sicher in der Erstellung und Kalkulation von Angeboten und bringst Verhandlungsgeschick mit.
 Du hast ein gutes Verständnis für Kunden- und Sponsorenanforderungen und kannst individuelle Konzepte und Leistungspakete entwickeln.
 Du arbeitest strukturiert, eigenverantwortlich und lösungsorientiert und behältst auch bei mehreren parallel laufenden Projekten den Überblick.
 Du kommunizierst souverän und professionell mit Kunden, Sponsoren, Partnern und Dienstleistern.
 Du arbeitest gerne an der Schnittstelle zwischen Commercial, Redaktion, Grafik und weiteren internen sowie externen Partnern.
 Du hast ein gutes Gespür für Marken, Medien und die professionelle Präsentation von Kunden- und Sponsoringprojekten.
 Du bist sicher im Umgang mit Präsentationen, Konzepten, Angeboten und Reportings.
 Du überzeugst durch Organisationstalent, Kommunikationsstärke und eine ausgeprägte Hands-on-Mentalität.
 Du arbeitest gerne eigenständig, übernimmst Verantwortung und bringst Projekte zuverlässig zum Abschluss.
 Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift sowie gute Englischkenntnisse runden dein Profil ab.
 Wir bieten
 Eine abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeit in einem kollegialen Team.
 Kurze Entscheidungswege, damit du deine Ideen ohne unnötige Bürokratie umsetzen kannst.
 Volle Flexibilität durch gleitende Arbeitszeiten
 Getränke und Snacks stehen zur Verfügung

jobs.title: Project Manager Digital Solutions (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Beratung, Projektleitung und Umsetzung in einer Rolle:
 von der ersten Anforderung bis zur Abnahme beim Kunden.
 Wir sind ein Hamburger Softwareunternehmen für Prozessberatung, Systemintegration und Entwicklung im Handel. Kunden wie REWE, EDEKA, hagebau, Vitra und die JAKO AG digitalisieren mit uns ihre Marketing- und Produktprozesse.
 Dein Einstieg bei der msp AG
 Auf Basis von Produktdaten sorgen wir dafür, dass Werbemittel automatisiert entstehen: Prospekte, Kataloge, Plakate und Online-Kampagnen, schneller und mit deutlich weniger Handarbeit.
 In dieser Rolle trägst Du ein Kundenvorhaben über die ganze Strecke: Du verstehst das Problem, entwirfst die Lösung, setzt sie selbst um und begleitest sie bis zur Abnahme. Projektmanagement, Beratung und Umsetzung liegen bei Dir in einer Hand. Das macht unsere Projekte schneller und für den Kunden günstiger.
 Früher hieß das: Konzept schreiben, an die Entwicklung übergeben, in Schleifen nachbessern. Bei uns bringst Du Dein Konzept mit KI selbst weit über den Prototyp hinaus und arbeitest dabei Hand in Hand mit unserer Entwicklung.
 Ganz ehrlich: Vieles in unserem neuen Team ist noch nicht fertig. Abläufe, Vorlagen und die Art, wie wir zusammenarbeiten, entstehen gerade. Wer hier einsteigt, legt selbst Hand an und gestaltet mit.
 Deine Aufgaben
 Projektverantwortung: Du verantwortest und steuerst Kundenprojekte: Umfang, Ablauf, Termine und kaufmännische Budgetverantwortung liegen in Deiner Hand.
 Beratung & Konzeption: Du berätst unsere Kunden zu fachlichen und technischen Fragen und entwickelst mit ihnen Konzepte, wie aus ihren Produktdaten automatisiert Werbemittel entstehen.
 Umsetzung mit KI: Einen großen Teil der Lösung baust Du mit KI selbst. Unsere Entwickler:innen arbeiten dabei eng mit Dir zusammen, prüfen Deine Umsetzung und bringen sie mit Dir in den Betrieb.
 Steuerung im Projekt: Du verantwortest das Anforderungsmanagement und priorisierst, was wann umgesetzt wird. Du sicherst Qualität und Termintreue, erkennst Risiken früh und schlägst Maßnahmen vor.
 Abnahme & Releases: Du führst Abnahme und Integration beim Kunden und begleitest Releases und Updates danach.
 Angebote & Abrechnung: Du erstellst projektbezogene Angebote, hältst Leistungen nach und bereitest die Abrechnung vor.
 Zusammenarbeit: Du arbeitest eng mit Produktentwicklung, Vertrieb und Marketing zusammen und bringst Erkenntnisse aus den Projekten ins Produkt zurück.
 Das bringst Du mit
 Studium: Du hast ein Studium mit guten Noten abgeschlossen, gern mit IT- oder Wirtschaftsbezug wie Wirtschaftsinformatik oder Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen.
 Projekterfahrung: Du hast bereits Projekte begleitet oder geführt, gern aus einer Beratung oder aus der Softwareentwicklung im Kundenumfeld.
 Analytisches Denken: Du durchdringst komplexe Anforderungen, erkennst das eigentliche Problem und entwickelst dafür eine tragfähige Lösung.
 Software-Strategie: Du verstehst, wie Softwarelösungen aufgebaut sind: Datenmodelle, Schnittstellen, Infrastruktur und Systemlandschaften. Dieses Verständnis befähigt Dich, Lösungen strategisch zu konzipieren, Kunden fundiert zu beraten und mit KI selbst zu entwickeln. Gerne mit eigener Programmiererfahrung.
 Lust auf KI: Du probierst neue KI-Tools aus, bevor jemand danach fragt, und willst herausfinden, wie man damit schneller und besser arbeitet. Für Dich ist KI das Werkzeug, mit dem aus einem Konzept direkt eine lauffähige Lösung wird.
 Kommunikation: Du schaffst Klarheit zwischen Kunde, Entwicklung und internen Teams, auch wenn Interessen auseinandergehen.
 Verbindlichkeit: Du triffst Entscheidungen, hältst Zusagen und meldest früh, wenn etwas aus dem Rahmen läuft.
 Sprachkompetenz: Du sprichst Deutsch verhandlungssicher und Englisch sicher.
 Das bieten wir Dir
 Wirkung: Lösungen für große Händler, an denen Deine Arbeit direkt sichtbar wird.
 Gestaltungsraum: Du bist früh dabei in einem neuen Team und prägst mit, wie es arbeitet.
 Alles in einer Hand: Beratung, Projektleitung und Umsetzung in einer Rolle, ohne die üblichen Übergabeverluste dazwischen.
 Rückendeckung: An den großen Weichenstellungen schaut Deine Teamleitung mit Dir gemeinsam auf die Lösung. Preisverhandlungen und harte Kostendiskussionen führt sie, damit Du Dich auf Kunde und Lösung konzentrieren kannst.
 Werkzeuge: KI-gestütztes Arbeiten gehört bei uns zum Alltag, nicht zum Pilotprojekt.
 Zusammenarbeit: flache Hierarchien, kurze Wege und Raum, Abläufe mitzugestalten.
 Standort: moderne Büroräume im Herzen Hamburgs, flexible Arbeitszeiten und mobiles Arbeiten.
 Vergütung: Wir bieten Dich eine leistungsgerechte Vergütung, die Deine Erfahrung, Dein Engagement und Deinen Impact widerspiegelt.
 Benefits on Top: Betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Zusatzversicherungen, Wellpass, Jobrad und ein zertifiziert familienfreundliches Umfeld.
 Mobilität: Parkplätze, S-Bahn-Anbindung und Deutschlandticket gratis.
 Lernen & Entwicklung: Wir fördern Deine persönliche und fachliche Weiterentwicklung mit individuellen Weiterbildungs

jobs.title: Technical Project Manager (EMEA)
jobs.description:
About Us 
 Constructor is the next-generation platform for search and discovery in ecommerce, built to explicitly optimize for metrics like revenue, conversion rate, and profit. Our search engine is entirely invented in-house utilizing transformers and generative LLMs, and we use its core and personalization capabilities to power everything from search itself to recommendations to shopping agents. Engineering is by far our largest department, and we’ve built our proprietary engine to be the best on the market, having never lost an A/B test to a competitive technology. We’re passionate about maintaining this and work on the bleeding edge of AI to do so.
 Out of necessity, our engine is built for extreme scale and powers over 1 billion queries every day across 150 languages and roughly 100 countries. It is used by some of the biggest ecommerce companies in the world like Sephora, Under Armour, and Petco.
 We’re a passionate team who love solving problems and want to make our customers’ and coworkers’ lives better. We value empathy, openness, curiosity, continuous improvement, and are excited by metrics that matter. We believe that empowering everyone in a company to do what they do best can lead to great things.
 Constructor is a U.S. based company that has been in the market since 2019. It was founded by Eli Finkelshteyn and Dan McCormick who still lead the company today.
 About the Position 
 We're looking for a proactive and highly organized Technical Project Manager to lead customer implementations across Constructor's product suite. You will lead onboardings for new customers as well as implementations of additional products for existing customers, owning each engagement from kickoff through activation. You will own the plan, the timeline, and the outcome, and you drive the people delivering it through a matrixed reporting structure. As we build toward an automation-first operating model, you will help standardize how implementations are run and increasingly act as a portfolio strategist, managing exceptions while repeatable, AI-assisted processes carry the routine work.
 You will: 
 • Lead multiple implementations end to end, both new-customer onboardings and additional-product rollouts for existing customers, from kickoff through integration, testing, and activation.
 • Take accountability for the outcome of every implementation, coordinating Constructor resources, customer resources, and partners, against a single shared plan.
 • Run kickoffs, set milestones, track dependencies, and maintain a clear, shared view of status for internal stakeholders and the customer.
 • Serve as the customer's primary point of contact through activation, setting expectations and communicating progress, risks, and changes in scope.
 • Identify risks and blockers early, escalate effectively, and keep implementations moving toward on-time, predictable delivery.
 • Ensure clean handoffs into implementation from Sales and out of implementation to Customer Success and Support.
 • Maintain implementation plans and reporting in our systems of record so schedule, duration, and status roll up cleanly across your portfolio.
 • Help build the repeatable processes, templates, and standards that let the function scale, and partner on the automation-first model as it matures.
 Role Responsibilities: Technical Project Management 
 • Own the Outcome: Be accountable for the success of each implementation from kickoff to activation, whether the work is delivered by Constructor, the customer, or a partner, standing behind on-time, predictable go-live for both new customers and existing-customer product rollouts.
 • Drive Every Contributor: Coordinate Constructor technical resources, customer resources, and partners against one plan, holding each accountable to their commitments through influence rather than authority.
 • Lead the Customer Experience: Serve as the primary point of contact through activation, running a clear communication rhythm and building customer confidence from kickoff to handoff.
 • Manage Handoffs & Risk: Ensure accurate handoffs from Sales into implementation and from implementation into Customer Success and Support, surfacing risk early and keeping delivery on track wherever the risk sits.
 • Build Scalable Process: Standardize how implementations are run at Constructor, maintain accurate tracking and reporting, and help advance the automation-first operating model as the function grows.
 Requirements 
 You Have 
 • At least 3 years of technical project management or onboarding project management experience, ideally in a SaaS environment.
 • A track record of owning delivery outcomes end to end and holding cross-functional contributors accountable through influence rather than direct authority.
 • Excellent organizational and communication skills, with the ability to run multiple implementations in parallel without losing the thread.
 • Customer-facing confidence: you can lead a kickoff, manage expectations, and kee

jobs.title: Product Owner – B2B SaaS (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Über uns
 CALIMA ist ein Berliner B2B-SaaS-Startup mit der Mission, Arbeitssicherheit durch digitale und innovative Lösungen einfacher, verlässlicher und wirksamer zu machen. Unsere Software unterstützt Unternehmen dabei, dass Alleinarbeitende im Notfall schnell Hilfe erhalten. CALIMA wird von über tausend Unternehmen genutzt und schützt täglich tausende Mitarbeitende.
 Wir sind ein kleines, ambitioniertes Team mit hohem Qualitätsanspruch. Wir arbeiten pragmatisch, produktnah und mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen. Dabei suchen wir Menschen, die Verantwortung übernehmen, mitdenken und unsere Prozesse aktiv verbessern.
 Deine Rolle
 Als Product Owner wirst du unsere erste fest angestellte Person im Produktmanagement und übernimmst die operative Produktverantwortung für unsere Entwicklungsteams: Cloud, Mobile Apps für iOS und Android sowie Platform.
 Aktuell liegen Backlog, Tickets und Planung direkt beim Head of Tech. Deine Aufgabe ist es, dafür zu sorgen, dass die Teams verlässlich an den richtigen Dingen arbeiten: ein gut sortiertes Backlog, klar definierte Tickets, ein funktionierendes Refinement und realistisch abgestimmte Deadlines. Du wirst das Bindeglied zwischen dem Head of Tech, den kleinen, remote arbeitenden Entwicklungsteams, QA, Sales und Customer Success.
 Wir entwickeln ein sicherheitsrelevantes Produkt. Zuverlässigkeit und Qualität stehen bei uns vor Feature-Menge.
 Perspektivisch kannst du deine Rolle in Richtung strategisches Product Management weiterentwickeln und Themen wie Roadmap, Markt und Produktstrategie aktiv mitgestalten.
 Deine Aufgaben
 Backlog und Tickets
 Du übersetzt Anforderungen aus Customer Success, Sales und Support in Epics und Tickets und klärst offene Fragen.

 Du pflegst ein priorisiertes Backlog je Team und stellst sicher, dass nur klar definierte Tickets in die Entwicklung gehen.

 Du formulierst Tickets mit Ziel, Akzeptanzkriterien und Abgrenzung so, dass Entwicklung und QA ohne Rückfragen starten können.

 Konzeption
 Du leitest aus Kundenfeedback und Anfragen von Sales und Customer Success ab, welches Problem dahintersteht und welche Verbesserung den größten Nutzen bringt.

 Du arbeitest Features konzeptionell aus, mit Zielbild, Abläufen und Edge Cases, bevor daraus Tickets werden.

 Du bewertest Lösungsvarianten gemeinsam mit den Entwickler:innen nach Nutzen, Aufwand und Risiko.

 Du sprichst gemeinsam mit Customer Success und Sales mit Kund:innen und prüfst Konzepte mit ihnen, bevor wir sie umsetzen.

 Planung und Steuerung
 Du bereitest die Quartalsplanung mit dem Head of Tech vor und findest die Balance zwischen Kapazitäten und Deadlines.

 Du moderierst Refinements, übernimmst nach der Einarbeitung die Moderation unserer Team-Weeklies, behältst Action Items im Blick und entwickelst die Produktkoordination und die zugehörigen Abläufe weiter.

 Du hältst die Boards aktuell, erkennst Blocker früh und eskalierst sie an die richtige Person.

 Schnittstellen
 Du bist zentrale Ansprechperson für Sales, CS und QA bei Fragen zu Status und Priorität.

 Du hältst Sales und Customer Success proaktiv auf dem Laufenden, wo ein Release steht und was sich verschiebt.

 Du steuerst, was in Benutzerhandbuch und Kundendokumentation landet.

 Du koordinierst unsere externen App-Entwickler:innen auf Ticketebene.

 Du lieferst die Inhalte für Release Notes und Team Testing.

 Deine ersten Monate
 In den ersten Wochen lernst du Team, Produkt und Kunden kennen und übernimmst Backlog und Tickets der Teams Schritt für Schritt.

 Danach moderierst du Refinements und Weeklies und baust mit uns einen Planungsrhythmus auf, der Fortschritt messbar macht.

 Nach etwa drei Monaten läuft die operative Produktarbeit über dich, und Sales und Customer Success wissen jederzeit, wo ein Release steht.

 Das bringst du mit
 Mehrjährige Erfahrung als Product Owner, Product Manager:in oder technische:r Projektmanager:in in der Softwareentwicklung, idealerweise in einem B2B-SaaS- oder Startup-Umfeld.

 Sicherer Umgang mit agilen Methoden sowie Erfahrung in Backlog-Management, Priorisierung, Sprint- und Releaseplanung und der Moderation agiler Meetings.

 Du schreibst Tickets, die Entwickler:innen gerne umsetzen: klar, vollständig, mit sauberen Akzeptanzkriterien.

 Genug technisches Verständnis, um Aufwände und Lösungsvorschläge zu hinterfragen, gerne mit Erfahrung in Web- und Mobile-Produkten.

 Erfahrung mit Ticketingsystemen wie GitHub Projects, Jira oder vergleichbaren Tools.

Our Story 

At thinkcell, we create powerful software solutions that help professionals be more efficient and productive. jobs.description:
Over Veloretti 
 Veloretti is een design-led lifestylemerk uit Amsterdam, ontstaan vanuit een heldere visie op hoe mensen zich door de stad bewegen. We ontwerpen fietsen en e-bikes die passen bij het moderne stadsleven: functioneel, doordacht en met veel aandacht voor design, detail en gebruik. Het product staat centraal, maar het merk gaat verder dan mobiliteit alleen. Veloretti beweegt zich op het snijvlak van design, lifestyle en stedelijke cultuur.
 Sinds 2022 horen we bij Pon.Bike. Met het oog op onze groei bouwen we aan de teams en cultuur voor de volgende fase van Veloretti.
 
 De rol 
 Als Product Owner Core Systems ben je verantwoordelijk voor de belangrijkste business- en operations-applicaties zoals het ERP-systeem en het Dealer Portal. Je combineert in deze functie de strategische doorontwikkeling met het dagelijkse management van de applicaties. Dankzij je hands-on ervaring in de applicaties en je goede analytische vaardigheden vertaal je de business behoefte naar goede oplossingen die onze externe development partners kunnen realiseren.
 
 Wat je doet 
 Beheer en prioriteer de backlog: Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de backlog van het ERP-systeem, het Dealer Portal en aangrenzende integraties en applicaties. Je vindt daarbij de balans tussen business value, technische haalbaarheid, effort en toekomstvastheid.

 Vertaal businessbehoeften naar oplossingen: Je werkt nauw samen met stakeholders en vertaalt functionele wensen naar een goed solution design en user stories. Je adviseert bovendien over verbeteringen in processen en IT-architectuur.

 Operationeel applicatiebeheer: Je bent het vaste aanspreekpunt voor het dagelijks beheer van de toegewezen core applicaties. Je faciliteert de operatie door processen optimaal te configureren, gebruikersomgevingen te beheren en applicatie-issues effectief op te lossen.

 Stuur externe ontwikkelpartners aan: Je leidt de samenwerking met onze IT-leveranciers om met het beschikbare budget de backlog zo efficiënt mogelijk te prioriteren

 Werk projectmatig en gestructureerd: Je analyseert de operationele- en business processen van je interne klant, brengt risico's in kaart en plant zorgvuldig om de voortgang en afhankelijkheden te coördineren.

 
 Wie we zoeken 
 We zoeken een analytisch sterke professional die zich net zo comfortabel voelt bij strategische procesarchitectuur als bij hands-on systeemconfiguratie. Je bezit de rust en het overzicht om complexe IT-vraagstukken te doorgronden, die goed uitgewerkt bij de externe development teams te beleggen en hebt de daadkracht om oplossingen zelfstandig te implementeren. Je bent communicatief sterk en daagt de business constructief uit om tot een goede oplossing te komen.

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager – Firefox Enterprise
jobs.description:
Why Mozilla

Mozilla Corporation is a non-profit-backed technology company that has helped shape the internet for the better over the past 25 years. We’re the makers of Firefox, the privacy-focused web browser used by more than 225 million people around the world each month. As we look to the future, we’re working to shape the next 25 years of the internet—one that’s built for people, not just for profit.

Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the 501(c) non-profit Mozilla Foundation, meaning we’re accountable not to shareholders, but to our mission. Alongside thousands of contributors and collaborators around the world, Mozillians design, build, and maintain open-source software that empowers people to use the internet on their own terms.

About this team and role

Firefox Enterprise is seeking a Staff Product Manager to own a major part of our 2027 product roadmap as we grow from our first release into a multi-product enterprise offering. This is a high-impact role for someone who has taken enterprise security products from zero to one. You will set direction, align engineering, design and go-to-market partners, and deliver.

This role is ideal for someone who can work across teams with empathy, build trust with a wide range of partners, and move work forward in a practical, low-ego way. You will join a small product team, and work closely with engineering, security, legal, sales and customers, including our first enterprise pilots. You do not need to know browsers inside out, but you do need to bring structure to ambiguity, make clear product decisions, and follow through. 

What You’ll Do

  • Own the strategy, roadmap and delivery of a major Firefox Enterprise workstream in 2027, starting with our hosted offering alongside the existing on-premise solution
  • Define requirements, success metrics and release plans, and work with engineering, design, security and infrastructure teams to ship them
  • Work with pilot customers and prospects, including IT, security and compliance teams, to understand their deployment needs and turn them into prioritized product decisions
  • Partner with sales, legal, finance and support on packaging, pricing inputs, go-to-market readiness and compliance
  • Contribute to a single cross-workstream roadmap, keeping dependencies, timelines and trade-offs visible to leadership and stakeholders
  • Take on new scope as the portfolio grows, including Thunderbird Enterprise and AI-related enterprise capabilities, and help mentor teammates and establish product practices
  • Champion Mozilla’s values in every interaction.

What You’ll Bring

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including taking 0-to-1 enterprise security or infrastructure products (such as identity, endpoint or infrastructure security) from definition through launch
  • Experience owning a hosted or SaaS security product, including data residency and operational requirements
  • Experience dealing with public sector organizations, with a working understanding of sovereignty requirements
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to translate nuanced topics to different audiences 
  • A strong track record of execution and follow-through; you are someone who helps teams turn ideas into action
  • Comfort with ambiguity, and experience setting direction for new products or markets
  • Experience working with engineering, design, security, legal and go-to-market teams to deliver cross-functional programs with strong outcomes

jobs.title: Product Manager, Homepage
jobs.description:
Our Global Structure 

 
Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

 Join us in shaping the experience that millions of customers land on every time they open DoorDash, Wolt, or Deliveroo. As part of our Core Consumer organisation, our Homepage team owns one of the single biggest levers we have on what customers find and one of the hardest surfaces in the app to get right.

 Working at the intersection of ranking, personalisation, and AI/ML, you'll help decide what each customer sees and why, across three brands and dozens of markets. You'll be building on a global stack, and your roadmap will be a mix: global platform problems that apply worldwide, global capabilities we're accelerating into EMEA, and EMEA-specific problems worth solving properly rather than working around.

 We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our Homepage team. In this role, you'll shape how customers discover restaurants, grocery and retail venues, dishes and products — and help define what discovery looks like as AI-driven and agentic experiences change the way people decide what to order.

 What You'll Be Doing 

 You'll be joining a team working on one of the most-used surfaces in the app.

 Here's what your day-to-day might look like:

 
 Building new end-to-end features and user experiences on Homepage that shape how customers discover restaurants, grocery and retail venues, dishes, and products.

 Working on ranking, personalisation, and AI/ML problems in the Homepage domain, including how we decide what each customer sees and why.

 Exploring where AI-driven and agentic experiences change the way customers discover what to order.

 Making discovery work across three brands and many markets, without flattening into one-size-fits-all.

 
 What You'll Need to Thrive 

 Our ideal candidate will bring strong product judgment and curiosity to grow into the rest:

 
 Proven experience as a Product Manager on consumer-facing products - discovery, homepage, feed, or ranking-driven experiences are especially relevant.

 You are a product manager more than a feature owner. Someone who finds the customer problems that matter most and makes the case for solving them.

 You work backwards from the customer problem, and weigh it against what the business needs most right now.

 You're comfortable holding several business objectives at once and making a call when they pull in different directions.

 You work well with a wide range of stakeholders and build trust with people whose priorities differ from your own.

 You think strategically and can move between long-term direction and what we should ship next.

 You're comfortable with ambiguity and genuinely flexible (this industry is changing fast, AI most of all).

 You're curious about what AI actually changes for customers, and can tell real value from hype.

 
 Next steps

 The position will be filled as soon as we find the right person, so make sure to apply as soon as you realize you really, really want to join us!

 
 Diversity, Equity and Inclusion 

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

 We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

 If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you'll have the opportunity to let us know once you've submitted your application. We'll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

 If you're excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we'd love to hear from you!

 
Beware of recruitment scams: DASH Brands will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about DASH Brands' legitimate recruiting process at careersatdoordash.com/recruitment-scam-awareness .

jobs.description:
Chez Lifen, nous pensons que les données médicales ont le potentiel de transformer le système de santé. Mais seulement si elles sont accessibles. Plus de données accessibles → moins de charge administrative, une meilleure coordination des soins et des découvertes scientifiques plus rapides.
 Depuis 2015, notre mission est de libérer ce potentiel. Nos solutions basées sur l'IA permettent aux professionnels de santé de partager les informations médicales sans effort et aux chercheurs d'accélérer les découvertes cliniques : avec un impact sur des millions de patients en France chaque jour. Alors que nous nous préparons à nous développer en Europe, 2 choses déterminent notre succès : nos équipes et notre mission.
 Aujourd'hui, plus de 150 personnes travaillent depuis nos bureaux et à distance pour libérer le potentiel des données de santé. Nous avons connecté 800 hôpitaux et 150 000 professionnels de santé, et nous ne faisons que commencer. Nous recherchons des personnes qui embrassent la complexité, veulent résoudre des problèmes difficiles et sont prêtes à construire le futur de la collaboration en santé.
 
 
 ⚡ Notre équipe Customer Operations 
 L’équipe Customer Operations accompagne les établissements de santé dans le déploiement et l’usage des solutions Lifen. Son travail conditionne une adoption durable : comprendre l’organisation de chaque client, coordonner les parties prenantes et faire avancer les projets jusqu’à leur mise en service.
 En tant que Project Manager, tu piloteras des déploiements auprès de grands comptes, notamment des groupements hospitaliers de territoire (GHT). Tu seras le point de repère côté Lifen pour structurer le projet, donner de la visibilité aux clients et lever les obstacles avec les équipes internes.
 
 
 🎯 Ce que tu feras chez nous 
 Cartographier les établissements, les services concernés et leurs besoins pour cadrer chaque déploiement.

 Construire le planning projet, poser les jalons et suivre leur avancement.

 Animer les réunions de suivi et formaliser les décisions.

 Coordonner Business Development, Customer Operations, Ops Manager et R&D.

 Suivre les usages après le déploiement et identifier les difficultés rencontrées sur le terrain.

 Centraliser les bugs et demandes d’évolution, puis communiquer sur les corrections et nouveautés.

 Tenir la documentation projet à jour et contribuer à faire évoluer les méthodes et processus de l’équipe.

 
 
 ⭐️ Ce que nous recherchons 
 Must-have
 Une solide expérience dans la gestion de projets, idéalement dans le déploiement de logiciels ou de solutions numériques.

 Une bonne connaissance fonctionnelle et technique du secteur de la santé et de l’organisation d’un établissement de santé.

 Des bases en interopérabilité, en flux de données et en FHIR.

 La capacité à cadrer en autonomie des projets simples, suivre un calendrier, identifier les blocages et solliciter son manager lorsque nécessaire.

 Une communication écrite et orale claire auprès de clients comme d’équipes internes.

 Nice-to-have
 Une expérience auprès de grands comptes hospitaliers ou de groupements d’établissements de santé.

 Une connaissance des enjeux techniques liés à l’architecture d’une plateforme logicielle et aux intégrations entre systèmes.

 L’habitude de former des utilisateurs sur des outils ou processus fonctionnels.

 Une bonne maîtrise de Notion, des outils Google ou Office et d’outils de suivi de projet.

 Soft skills
 Tu sais organiser ton travail sans attendre qu’on te donne chaque prochaine étape, tout en signalant rapidement les risques ou les dépendances. Tu aimes comprendre le fonctionnement concret d’un client avant de proposer une solution. Face à des interlocuteurs aux priorités différentes, tu gardes le cap, tu reformules et tu fais avancer les décisions.
 
 
 Nos valeurs
 Embrace Complexity : tu prends le temps de comprendre les contraintes d’un établissement, les dépendances techniques et les besoins des utilisateurs.
 Bienveillance : tu communiques avec clarté, écoutes les difficultés et cherches des solutions avec les parties prenantes.
 Real Impact : tu veilles à ce que les solutions déployées soient réellement utilisées et facilitent le travail des professionnels de santé.
 
 
 👥 Process de recrutement 
 Échange avec Laura, Talent Acquisition - 30 min. Un premier échange pour comprendre ton parcours, tes attentes et ta motivation pour le poste.

 Entretien avec Loïc, Hiring Manager - 45 min. Une première rencontre avec ton potentiel futur manager qui approfondira ton expérience de gestion de projet et de déploiement, ta compréhension des environnements de santé et ta connaissance fonctionnelle des produits déployés.

 Étude de cas avec Loïc et un membre de l’équipe Customer Ops - 60 à 90 min. Quelques jours avant l’échange, nous t’enverrons une étude de cas à préparer. jobs.title: (Senior) Product Manager Heating & Cooling (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
1KOMMA5°

 At 1KOMMA5° , we pursue a clear vision: Living on wind and sunlight forever for free . To make this a reality, we are building the energy system of the future with Heartbeat AI. Want to be part of it? 

 We bring together regional craftsmanship and scalable software: We don't think of solar, batteries, heat pumps, and e-mobility as isolated components, but control them as an intelligent, integrated overall system in our virtual power plant. Directly connected to the electricity market – in real time, fully automated. This way, energy is used when it is available from renewables and particularly cost-effective. By 2030, our goal is to transition 1.5 million households to renewable energies. Over 3,000 people are working towards this every day, at more than 80 locations worldwide, from Finland to Australia. 

 Want to take responsibility and build solutions that truly matter? Apply now and help us shape the energy world of tomorrow. 

 Learn about our Product & Tech team!

 Your mission

 As Senior Product Manager for Heating & Cooling, you own Heat as a product. What must be true in the household: space heating, hot water, and cooling people can trust, at a cost that makes sense, controlled with Heartbeat. 

 You decide where Heating & Cooling goes next. Which problems we solve first. How hardware partners, the Energy Management System, and the customer experience add up to one result — in Germany and in the other markets we operate in. You own the problem, the requirements, and the outcomes. 

 Your main focus will be to:

 
 Own the product strategy and roadmap for Heating & Cooling: where the area goes, and how it evolves across markets

 Define the customer outcome (comfort, cost, control, reliability) and the KPIs that prove it

 Turn hardware and field constraints into product requirements. Cut work that does not serve the outcome.

 Drive thermal optimization on our Energy Management System

 Align hardware, the Energy Management System, and the customer experience so households get one heat and cooling experience

 Write specs, run discovery, prioritize, and ship

 
 Your profile

 You have: 

 
 5+ years of Product Management on hardware-software products, energy, HVAC, or similarly physical systems

 A track record of owning a customer outcome across more than one engineering team

 Comfort at the seam of OEM interfaces, optimization, and customer UX

 Excellent English and German

 Based in Germany or willing to relocate

 
 Bonus points for:

 
 Heat pumps, SG Ready, EEBus, Modbus, OEM cloud APIs

 Field or installer experience

 Thermal optimization or HEMS with heat pumps

 Heating and cooling products across more than one country

 
 Benefits

 
 You are part of an international, dynamic, and highly motivated team of people who have proven to make things happen

 With your work, you accelerate the "energy transition" and hence have a direct impact on our climate

 Work with and learn from other super-smart colleagues

 You will enjoy direct contact with core decision-makers

 You will enjoy the best chances of entering full-time in one of Europe’s most thriving scaleups

 You work remotely (Germany-wide), with offices in Hamburg, Berlin or Munich

 Create a healthy balance alongside your work and enjoy all the benefits of the EGYM Wellpass

 Benefits and discounts are yours with Futurebens

jobs.title: Senior Hardware Project Manager (All genders)
jobs.description:
At Stark, we forge the future of European and national security through cutting-edge, AI-driven technology and unmatched engineering precision. As a premier defence technology company, our mission is clear: to equip NATO Allies and their partners  with next-generation autonomous defence platforms and advanced AI-driven software built to perform in the world’s most demanding environments.

We believe that true security stems from relentless innovation. By combining elite engineering talent with agile technology and an AI-native operational culture, Stark turns complex defence challenges into field-tested, multi-domain solutions.

WHY JOIN US

  • The software and systems you work on directly protect personnel and defend European and national sovereignty.
  • You will work alongside industry-leading minds on autonomous systems, advanced propulsion, and secure cyber platforms.
  • We foster a fast-paced, collaborative environment where bold ideas are supported by serious R&D backing.

ABOUT THE TEAM

You will join our cross-functional hardware engineering group focused on delivering next-generation autonomous defence platforms. Our team collaborates closely across mechanical, electrical, and systems engineering to bring complex hardware projects from initial design to field readiness. We value agile execution, rigorous technical standards, and open communication in a fast-paced environment.

YOUR MISSION

As Senior Hardware Project Manager, you will oversee the full lifecycle of complex hardware engineering projects for next-generation autonomous defence systems. You will lead cross-functional engineering teams, manage hardware supply chains, and align project milestones with company strategic goals to deliver field-tested, mission-critical hardware solutions.

WHAT YOU WILL DO AT STARK

PLOS is a nonprofit Open Access publisher with an ambitious mission: to help transform research communication so that science can be shared, understood and used more effectively. 

Research publishing is changing rapidly. Researchers' expectations are changing. Technology is creating possibilities that didn't exist a few years ago. And at PLOS we're rethinking some of the services, systems and assumptions that have shaped scholarly publishing for decades. 

That means there are interesting product problems to solve - not just features to deliver. 

You'll take responsibility for a product area and work with designers, engineers and colleagues across PLOS to understand the problems that matter, work out where we can make the greatest difference and help the team learn its way towards good solutions. 

You'll be joining active product teams working on significant problems and will have plenty of opportunity to shape what we do and how we do it. 

 

How we work 

We want our product teams to be curious, evidence-led and comfortable with uncertainty. 

We don't expect a Product Manager to arrive with all the answers. We do expect them to ask good questions. 

You'll use continuous discovery alongside delivery: spending time with users, looking at data, understanding the wider service, identifying assumptions and finding practical ways to test them. 

You'll help the team break large problems into smaller things we can learn from, rather than waiting until everything is known before we release something. 

And you'll make the team's thinking visible - explaining what we're trying to achieve, what we've learned, what we're uncertain about and why we're making the choices we are. 

 

Responsibilities

As a Senior Product Manager, you'll: 

  • Understand the problem. Build a deep understanding of our users, their needs and behaviours, as well as the organisational, operational and technical context surrounding them. 
  • Shape product direction. Work out where the greatest opportunities lie within your area and help translate PLOS's objectives into clear product outcomes and priorities. 
  • Practise continuous discovery. Work closely with design, engineering and others to explore problems, identify assumptions and regularly test ideas with users and through data. 
  • Turn uncertainty into learning. Frame hypotheses, design useful experiments and look for the smallest sensible way to learn whether we're heading in the right direction. 
  • Make good product decisions. Weigh evidence, impact, effort, risk and opportunity when deciding what to pursue - and what not to pursue.

 a feel for what the numbers should look like

 Comfort working hands-on: writing and resolving tickets, prototyping, and making implementation and design decisions yourself.

 The ability to lead through influence across Credit, Growth, Design, Data Science and Compliance. You change your mind when presented with a good argument, and you expect others to do the same.

 Nice to have 
 Experience with consumer credit lifecycle levers such as credit line management, pricing, and retention and reactivation.

 Experience shaping mobile app journeys for activation and engagement.

 A quick chat with someone from our Talent team to see if the role is a good match.

 An interview with the Hiring Manager , covering your experience and how you approach the work.

 A practical exercise or case study relevant to the role, discussed with the team you'd be working with.

 A set of final interviews to assess how you'd thrive within our team and organisation.

 Winning team: the opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies

 Flexible working: flexible approach tailored to each role. Hybrid roles require three days

adjoe builds the technologies behind mobile apps growth and monetization. With our core product Playtime , we've become the global leader in rewarded advertising, an ad unit built on a simple premise: users earn real in-app rewards for engaging with new apps. The result is one of the most effective value exchanges in adtech, connecting advertisers and publishers with over 770 million users annually
 Creating solutions that run on 13% of the world’s smartphones 
 The Mobile Integrations team builds the core technology that turns advertising from an interruption into a rewarded experience for 770 million users. We own the robust, lightweight, integration layer between our ad engine and the global mobile ecosystem, ensuring our technology operates with minimal overhead while reaching a massive portion of the smartphone market.
 On the client side, our technology performs smoothly across 20 million daily SDK initializations. We build native Swift and Kotlin SDKs optimized for ms initialization and minimal binary overhead, with Unity, Flutter, and React Native wrappers that provide a unified API across the entire mobile ecosystem. Behind the scenes, a high-throughput Go and DynamoDB architecture handles the real-time state synchronization of millions of concurrent sessions. When your code runs on nearly one out of every seven smartphones on Earth, every millisecond of execution and every byte of memory counts.

 Own and prioritize the Mobile SDK product backlog, balancing customer needs, business priorities, technical requirements, and engineering capacity.

 Work closely with Android, iOS, Backend, QA, and other stakeholders to manage dependencies, resolve blockers, and ensure smooth delivery.

 Gather and analyze feedback from customers, developers, and internal teams to identify integration pain points and opportunities to improve the SDK and developer experience.

 Support SDK releases and rollouts, including release planning, documentation, adoption tracking, and communication with relevant stakeholders.

 Use product data, SDK telemetry, and feedback to measure outcomes, identify opportunities, and continuously improve the Mobile SDK platform.

 You bring 3+ years of hands-on experience as a Product Owner in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. (Bonus points if you have a background in ad-tech or Mobile/SDKs)

 You have a proven track record of leveraging A/B testing and experimentation to drive product strategy. You know exactly how to define clear success metrics, analyze KPIs, and confidently pivot based on what the data tells you.

 You are a digital native who speaks the language of both business and engineering fluidly. You excel at closing the gap, aligning what the business envisions with what the technology can actually execute.

 You take deep ownership of your product. You are comfortable navigating ambiguity, working independently, and making the objective calls needed to balance incoming business requests with the long-term technical integrity of the platform.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager – JetBrains Air (Agentic Development in IDEs)
jobs.description:
Are you comfortable navigating complex software systems, working with coding agents, and defining what makes developer tools actually useful? Do you want to shape how developers and AI work together inside IDEs?

About JetBrains

We create intelligent software development tools for developers and teams. More than 15 million users, over 300,000 companies, and 88 of the Fortune Global Top 100 rely on our products to solve real, complex problems. Our mission is simple: make development teams more productive and AI adoptable at scale.

What you’ll do

Agentic development is changing how software gets built. Developers no longer just chat with AI – they delegate tasks, run parallel agent sessions, and steer autonomous changes. As agents take on more work, reviewing and owning the output is becoming the hardest part of the process. 

JetBrains Air is our open system for agentic development. It brings tools like Codex, GitHub Copilot, Claude Agent, Gemini, and Junie directly into JetBrains IDEs, providing an agentic-first user experience.

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead key areas of Air. You’ll take ownership of high-impact workflows, work closely with cross-functional teams (including software engineers, designers, ML researchers, analysts, DevRel, and product marketing), and turn technical complexity into clear product direction.

Day to day, you will:

  • Take end-to-end ownership of key parts of Air in JetBrains IDEs, driving work from problem framing and discovery to delivery, adoption, and iteration.
  • Define and refine core agentic workflows, including task delegation, session monitoring, steering, and code review.
  • Model complex user flows, system states, permissions, and integration schemes to guide engineering and design decisions.
  • Maintain a transparent roadmap that balances quick improvements with long-term strategic investments.
  • Define telemetry, design experiments, analyze product data, and make evidence-based roadmap decisions.
  • Study how developers interact with leading AI agents and tools to inform product priorities.
  • Engage with the Agent Client Protocol (ACP) ecosystem and collaborate with partners building on it.
  • Partner with enterprise sales and support teams to address governance, privacy, and control requirements.

What you’ll bring

  • A systems-thinking mindset that easily breaks down complex architectures, workflows, and dependencies.
  • A data-driven approach to product decisions, including hands-on experience querying and analyzing telemetry.
  • Active personal experience using coding agents and clear perspectives on where current AI tools succeed and fail.
  • Strong product intuition for complex technical user experiences and developer workflows.
  • Clear, concise, and collaborative communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts simply and build alignment across diverse groups of stakeholders.
  • Comfort navigating fast-changing technical landscapes with high ambiguity.

What you’ll need

  • Proven experience shipping end-user products as a product manager or in a similar role.
  • Strong technical grounding in software development workflows, including IDEs, git, code review, CI/CD, and package management.
  • A hands-on technical background sufficient to collaborate closely with software and ML engineers.
  • An understanding of core AI and agent concepts, including tool use, protocols (MCP/ACP), context retrieval, evaluations, and latency/cost trade-offs.
  • The ability to write SQL or Python to analyze product metrics and experiment results independently.
  • Fluency in English, both written and spoken.

What success looks like

In your first 6 to 12 months, success in this role means:

  • Driving measurable growth in active Air users and improving weekly/monthly retention (D7/D30).
  • Increasing agent session completion rates and the proportion of agent-generated changes accepted by developers.
  • Establishing clear, telemetry-backed decisions across your product roadmap areas.
  • Delivering validated product hypotheses consistently each quarter.
  • Contributing directly to JetBrains AI revenue growth and overall IDE value.

Why join JetBrains?

  • Strong base salary – We offer competitive pay that reflects your skills and experience.
  • Flexible work schedule – Enjoy the freedom to work from home or from the office.
  • Extra time off – More days to relax, recharge, and do the things you love.
  • Learning and development opportunities – Access to conferences, courses, and language classes.
  • Free meals and sna
